title: How Not To Design Expert Bureaucracy: Lessons From Administrative Law
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin – School of Law

detail.title: How Not To Design Expert Bureaucracy: Lessons From Administrative Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationships associated with my study.
declarations.funderStatement: University of Texas School of Law (my employer)

contentType.other: U. of North Carolina L. Rev. (forthcoming)

detail.abstract:
Can we trust our agency experts to provide reliable scientific knowledge to inform policy? This question has worried academics, policymakers, and the general public for decades. Now, in the wake of expert agency debacles during COVID, the advent of a new presidential administration, and a Supreme Court intent on reshaping the structure of administrative law, these concerns are escalating.

This article offers one answer to this question by examining the architecture of administrative law itself, and the findings are not comforting. Under the law as currently designed, political officials within U.S. agencies and the White House––regardless of the president in power––can exert unrestricted control over the scientific staff at all stages of their work while also protecting these political interventions from public disclosure as deliberative process. And, while administrative law assumes that vigorous engagement by affected stakeholders will ensure the resultant work is at least not “arbitrary” in health and environmental regulation, the notice-and-comment processes are typically monopolized by the same corporate interests that enlisted the political officials in the first place. At the same time, the staff’s anticipation of the resultant one-sided litigation only serves to introduce more biasing pressures on the objectivity of the work. And, if that were not enough, the deployment of elaborate external peer review processes, which are viewed as providing the last word on the quality of agency science, are entrusted not to disinterested scientists but to political officials. These officials enjoy ultimate control over the selection of scientists as peer reviewers and implementation of the review process, again in ways that remain largely undisclosed and often undocumented. As a result of this overarching legal design, even the most committed scientific staff find themselves impeded and sometimes blocked from producing work that has integrity, both with regard to scientific factfinding and to the identification of residual uncertainties. Indeed, it is not hyperbole to suggest that if one wants to know how NOT to design an expert bureaucracy, they should look to U.S. administrative law.

AI.tldr: 美国行政法体系允许政治官员对机构科学工作施加无限制控制，同时保护这些干预不被公开披露，导致科学工作的完整性受到系统性损害。
AI.research_question: 美国行政法体系是否能够确保机构专家提供可靠的科学知识来指导政策制定？
AI.motivation: 在COVID期间专家机构失误、新政府上任和最高法院重塑行政法结构的背景下，对专家机构可靠性的担忧日益加剧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法理论、专家官僚机构理论、科学政策互动理论
AI.method: 法律体系分析，考察行政法的制度设计及其对科学工作的影响
AI.findings: 现行行政法允许政治官员无限制控制科学工作，保护干预不被披露；公众参与过程被企业利益垄断；外部同行评审由政治官员控制，导致科学工作完整性受损。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行政法制度设计如何系统性损害科学工作的客观性和完整性，挑战了行政法确保科学可靠性的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改革行政法体系以保护科学完整性提供了理论基础，指出了制度设计的具体缺陷和改进方向。

title: Trumpian Populism and the Changing Intellectual Landscape in Antitrust: Century-Old Resonances, the New Right, and the Possible End of an Era
affiliations: American University - Washington College of Law

detail.title: Trumpian Populism and the Changing Intellectual Landscape in Antitrust: Century-Old Resonances, the New Right, and the Possible End of an Era
detail.abstract: Senior enforcement officials in the second Trump administration describe their approach to antitrust as "conservative," but their Trumpian populist worldview differs markedly from that of the Chicagoans who have been the primary conservative voices in antitrust policy making since the Reagan administration. The Trumpian populist perspective appears aligned with the intellectual frameworks of the New Right and the Lochner era Supreme Court. Those frameworks are consistent with strong antitrust enforcement but would also allow for enforcement to be circumscribed. Trumpian populism could mark an end to the eighty-year era in which economic regulatory policy was guided by the pursuit of inclusive economic growth, and instead lead to instability in antitrust enforcement policy reminiscent of the early 20th century. Antitrust, which until recently seemed settled and technocratic, now has a substantially less predictable future.

AI.tldr: 特朗普政府的反垄断执法官员自称"保守派"，但其民粹主义世界观与里根以来的芝加哥学派保守派截然不同，更接近新右翼和洛克纳时代的理念。这种观点支持强力反垄断执法，但也允许执法受限，可能导致反垄断政策不稳定，结束八十年来追求包容性经济增长的监管传统。

AI.method: 理论分析和政策框架比较
AI.findings: 特朗普民粹主义与芝加哥学派保守派在反垄断政策上存在显著差异，前者更接近新右翼和洛克纳时代的理念，可能导致反垄断执法政策的不稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了特朗普民粹主义作为一种新的反垄断政策框架，区别于传统的芝加哥学派保守主义。

title: The role of learning motivation in linking regulatory emotional self-efficacy to professional identity among vocational medical students: a universal pathway across active and passive major choices
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The role of learning motivation in linking regulatory emotional self-efficacy to professional identity among vocational medical students: a universal pathway across active and passive major choices

keywords.keywords: Regulatory emotional self-efficacyLearning motivationProfessional identityAutonomyVocational education

detail.abstract: Objective：This study investigated the impact of autonomy in major choice on regulatory emotional self-efficacy (RESE), learning motivation (LM), and professional identity (PI) among vocational medical students, testing LM as a mediator between RESE and PI, and the model’s universality.Methods: In this cross-sectional study, 322 first-year vocational medical students were divided into an active choice group (n = 155) and a passive choice group (n = 177) based on their reasons for selecting their major. Participants completed validated scales measuring RESE, LM, and PI. Group comparisons were conducted using independent samples t-tests, and mediation analysis was performed using bootstrapping procedures.Results: Students in the active choice group reported significantly higher levels of RESE (t = 2.227, p < 0.05), LM (t = 3.679, p < 0.05), and PI (t = 6.779, p < 0.001) than those in the passive choice group. Crucially, LM fully mediated the relationship between RESE and PI (indirect effect β = 0.348, 95% CI [0.260, 0.456]). This mediating pathway was statistically significant and stable within both the active and passive choice groups.Conclusion s: Autonomy in major choice serves as a crucial prerequisite for building psychological resources. More importantly, learning motivation acts as a full and universal mediator, translating regulatory emotional self-efficacy into stronger professional identity. These findings suggest that beyond encouraging autonomous choice, educational interventions designed to enhance emotional self-efficacy and learning motivation can effectively foster professional identity across the entire student population, including those who did not actively choose their field of study.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了专业选择自主性对职业医学生情绪调节自我效能感、学习动机和专业认同的影响，发现学习动机在情绪调节自我效能感与专业认同之间起完全中介作用，且这一中介路径在主动选择组和被动选择组中均稳定存在。
AI.research_question: 专业选择自主性如何影响职业医学生的情绪调节自我效能感、学习动机和专业认同？学习动机是否在情绪调节自我效能感与专业认同之间起中介作用？
AI.motivation: 了解专业选择自主性对学生心理发展和专业认同形成的影响，为教育干预提供理论依据，帮助包括被动选择专业在内的所有学生建立更强的专业认同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自我决定理论，探讨自主性选择对心理资源构建的影响；结合情绪调节自我效能感理论和专业认同理论，构建中介模型。
AI.method: 横断面研究设计，322名一年级职业医学生分为主动选择组（n=155）和被动选择组（n=177），使用验证量表测量情绪调节自我效能感、学习动机和专业认同，采用独立样本t检验进行组间比较，使用bootstrap程序进行中介分析。
AI.findings: 主动选择组学生在情绪调节自我效能感、学习动机和专业认同方面均显著高于被动选择组；学习动机在情绪调节自我效能感与专业认同之间起完全中介作用（间接效应β=0.348），且这一中介路径在两组中均稳定存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了学习动机作为情绪调节自我效能感与专业认同之间的完全中介变量，扩展了专业认同形成机制的理论模型；证明了中介路径的普遍性，为理论模型的外部效度提供支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育实践提供重要启示：除了鼓励自主选择外，通过提升情绪调节自我效能感和学习动机的教育干预，可以有效促进所有学生（包括被动选择者）的专业认同发展。

title: Predicting Early Gestational Diabetes Mellitus and Optimizing Resource Allocation: Cost-Effective Patient Intervention Using Machine Learning and Optimization Techniques
affiliations: Asia e University (AeU), Open University of Sri Lanka and Imperial College London - West Middlesex University Hospital

detail.title: Predicting Early Gestational Diabetes Mellitus and Optimizing Resource Allocation: Cost-Effective Patient Intervention Using Machine Learning and Optimization Techniques
detail.abstract: Aims To evaluate machine learning models for predicting Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and optimize intervention strategies using improved risk scores within the limitations of healthcare resources.Methods A public GDM dataset comprising 3,525 patient records with 17 clinical characteristics underwent preprocessing by median/mode imputation and SMOTE balancing. Ten machine learning algorithms were trained and assessed utilizing accuracy, precision, recall, ROC-AUC and F1-score criteria. Enhanced risk scores integrating anticipated probability (60%), gestational history (15%), pregnancy history (15%), and clinical variables (10%) were formulated. Five optimization scenarios (Conservative Budget, Moderate Budget, Aggressive Intervention, High-Risk Only, Maximum Coverage) were assessed utilizing greedy selection algorithms to identify cost-efficient patient selection strategies. SHAP values facilitated model interpretability.Results The Random Forest model attained peak performance, with an F1-score of 0.9771 and a ROC-AUC of 0.9981. The Conservative Budget scenario had the greatest cost-effectiveness (0.0013 benefit per dollar) by selecting 20 high-risk patients within a $15,000 budget, attaining an average risk score of 97.1%. Maximum Coverage selected 60 patients (20.9% coverage) but demonstrated reduced cost-effectiveness (0.0011). Essential predictive variables encompassed OGTT, BMI, and systolic blood pressure.Conclusions Optimization driven by machine learning markedly improves the efficiency of healthcare resource allocation for gestational diabetes mellitus management. Strategic patient selection utilizing improved risk score demonstrates more cost-effectiveness than broad coverage methods, offering evidence-based frameworks for prioritizing interventions in resource-limited environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估机器学习模型预测妊娠期糖尿病(GDM)的效果，并基于改进的风险评分优化医疗资源分配策略。随机森林模型表现最佳，通过不同预算场景分析发现保守预算策略具有最高成本效益。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习模型预测妊娠期糖尿病并优化医疗资源分配策略？

AI.method: 使用包含3,525条记录的公共GDM数据集，预处理后训练10种机器学习算法，构建改进的风险评分系统，并评估5种预算优化场景。

AI.practical_contributions: 为资源有限的医疗环境提供了基于证据的干预优先级框架，证明策略性患者选择比广泛覆盖方法更具成本效益。

title: The Political Economy of Pollution Remediation on Public Lands
affiliations: HEC Montreal - Department of Finance and HEC Montreal - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Political Economy of Pollution Remediation on Public Lands

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how investment in pollution remediation differs between different types of federal land. We draw on a unique dataset of 157,017 potentially contaminated sites in Canada. When we isolate Indigenous territories, we find that, compared to other types of federal land, Indigenous territories are 19.8% more likely to be contaminated, progress more slowly toward pollution remediation, and that the investment in the remediation process of contaminated sites is on average 77.3% lower in Indigenous territories. We propose a number of possible explanations for our results, notably the tragedy of the anti-common and inefficiencies associated with multilevel governance.

title: Integrated Analysis of Informality, Minimum Wage, And Monopsony Power: A Synthesis of Meta-Analyses with Unified Theoretical Underpinnings

detail.title: Integrated Analysis of Informality, Minimum Wage, And Monopsony Power: A Synthesis of Meta-Analyses with Unified Theoretical Underpinnings
detail.abstract: This document offers a synthesis of recent economic literature on three interconnected areas of labor markets: informality, the effects of the minimum wage, and monopsony power. Through the consolidation and meta-analysis of findings from multiple existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses, their causes, consequences, and associated public policies are examined. It is concluded that conventional views on these topics often overestimate the magnitude of effects. Policies to reduce informality based solely on lowering formalization costs are largely ineffective, while increased enforcement at the extensive margin shows more promising results. The effects of the minimum wage on employment, measured through the own-wage elasticity (OWE), are consistently modest, suggesting that job losses are limited compared to wage gains. To reconcile and microfound these findings, an integrated theoretical model of firm optimization is introduced, simultaneously incorporating firm heterogeneity, monopsony power, and endogenous formality decisions, rigorously demonstrating how the interaction of these forces can explain the observed empirical regularities. A cross-cutting and significant finding is the omnipresence of publication bias across all these study areas, which tends to inflate the magnitude of the effects reported in the published literature. Corrected estimates of the effects generally approach zero. Meta-regression is established as an indispensable tool for identifying heterogeneity and the true underlying effects in the empirical evidence, compelling a recalibration of both theory and economic policy recommendations towards a more nuanced and integrated approach.

AI.tldr: 本文通过整合和元分析现有系统综述和元分析，重新评估了劳动力市场中的非正规性、最低工资效应和买方垄断权力。研究发现传统观点高估了这些效应的大小，政策建议需要更细致和整合的方法。

title: KOMPARASI RETURN DAN RISIKO SAHAM SYARIAH DAN KONVENSIONAL PADA JII DAN IDX30 PERIODE 2019-2023
affiliations: State University of Ar-Raniry and State University of Ar-Raniry

detail.title: KOMPARASI RETURN DAN RISIKO SAHAM SYARIAH DAN KONVENSIONAL PADA JII DAN IDX30 PERIODE 2019-2023
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to compare the average return and risk of Islamic stocks and conventional stocks in the Jakarta Islamic Index (JII) and IDX30. This study uses stock return and risk variables obtained from the calculation of historical stock price data. Data is taken from the IDX website which provides data on Islamic stock companies listed on the JII and data on conventional stock companies listed on the IDX for the 2019-2023 period and the Yahoo Finance website which provides monthly stock closing price data on the JII and IDX during the 2019-2023 period. The population of this study were 30 Islamic stock issuers in JII and 30 conventional stock issuers in IDX30. Sample withdrawal using purposive sampling method so as to obtain 3 Islamic stocks and 5 conventional stocks for the 2019-2023 period. Data analysis uses descriptive and inferential statistics using a t-test to draw conclusions. The results of the Independent Sample T-Test difference test show that the return variable obtained a significance value of 0.777>0.05 and the risk variable obtained a significance value of 0.209>0.05. It can be concluded that Islamic stocks and conventional stocks do not show significantly different levels of return and risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了雅加达伊斯兰指数(JII)和IDX30中伊斯兰股票与传统股票的平均回报和风险。通过对2019-2023年期间3只伊斯兰股票和5只传统股票的分析，发现两者在回报和风险方面没有显著差异。
AI.research_question: 伊斯兰股票与传统股票在平均回报和风险方面是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 比较伊斯兰股票和传统股票的表现差异，为投资者提供投资决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合理论和风险-回报权衡理论，分析不同类型股票的投资特性。
AI.method: 使用描述性统计和推断统计（独立样本t检验），分析2019-2023年期间JII和IDX30的股票数据。
AI.findings: 伊斯兰股票和传统股票在回报（p=0.777）和风险（p=0.209）方面均无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 为伊斯兰金融与传统金融的比较研究提供了实证证据，挑战了伊斯兰股票具有不同风险回报特征的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在选择伊斯兰股票或传统股票时提供了决策依据，表明两者在风险回报特征上相似。

title: Why Both Accuracy and Interpretability Matter: Machine Learning for Nowcasting Thai GDP

detail.title: Why Both Accuracy and Interpretability Matter: Machine Learning for Nowcasting Thai GDP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research exclusively uses publicly available, aggregated macroeconomic data, and therefore, no human subjects, confidential information, or personally identifiable data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares that no funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This study develops a pseudo real-time framework for nowcasting Thailand's GDP growth, demonstrating why both accuracy and interpretability matter in policy contexts. The framework introduces Knowledge-Embedded Nowcasting (KEN) for variable selection and the Level of Alignment in Interpretative Signals (LAIS), a human-centered approach to evaluating interpretability. Results show machine learning models are promising but often less stable than econometric methods due to data sensitivity. Findings confirm that in high-stakes policy-making, accuracy is insufficient; interpretability promotes trust and supports decision-making. This study provides a reference for central banks and other institutions seeking to integrate machine learning models into their forecasting toolkits.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个伪实时框架来预测泰国GDP增长，证明了在政策背景下准确性和可解释性的重要性。该框架引入了知识嵌入预测（KEN）进行变量选择和对齐水平在解释信号（LAIS）来评估可解释性。结果显示机器学习模型有前景但不如计量经济学方法稳定，在政策制定中可解释性比准确性更重要。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个既准确又可解释的GDP实时预测框架？
AI.motivation: 在政策制定中，仅靠准确性不足以建立信任，需要可解释性来支持决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识嵌入预测（KEN）和解释信号对齐水平（LAIS）理论框架。
AI.method: 伪实时框架，结合机器学习模型和计量经济学方法，使用KEN进行变量选择，LAIS评估可解释性。
AI.findings: 机器学习模型有前景但数据敏感性高，不如计量经济学方法稳定；在政策制定中可解释性比准确性更重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了KEN和LAIS理论框架，强调可解释性在预测中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行等机构将机器学习模型整合到预测工具包中提供了参考。

title: Macroeconomic and Institutional Determinants of Non-Performing Loans: A Conceptual and Global Review
affiliations: Western Sydney University

detail.title: Macroeconomic and Institutional Determinants of Non-Performing Loans: A Conceptual and Global Review
detail.abstract:
This study combines empirical evidence and theoretical models from global research to develop a comprehensive framework for understanding the determinants of non-performing loans (NPLs). The framework links macroeconomic, institutional, and bank-specific factors to explain variations in credit risk across different economies. It moves beyond isolated methods by viewing NPL formation as driven by seven interacting mechanisms: the economic cycle, financial accelerator, poor management, skimping, moral hazard, institutional weakness, and the soft budget constraint. This integrated approach demonstrates how macroeconomic trends and managerial behaviour together affect credit quality. The analysis shows that while macroeconomic factors such as GDP growth and unemployment are important drivers of NPL dynamics, their effects are significantly shaped by institutional quality. Weak governance, corruption, and moral hazard consistently emerge as key elements that distort lending practices and increase systemic risk across advanced, emerging, and developing economies. The review concludes with targeted policy recommendations aimed at strengthening financial resilience, mainly through macroprudential coordination and institutional reform. This presentation is based on a comprehensive conceptual review, with the original preprint available on SSRN [SSRN ID 5593250]. It contributes to academic literature by offering a unified analytical framework and providing practical insights for policymakers and financial institutions facing increased global uncertainty.

This presentation was developed as a follow-up to “Macroeconomic and Institutional Determinants of Non-Performing Loans: A Conceptual and Global Review” by the same author.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合全球研究的实证证据和理论模型，开发了一个理解不良贷款决定因素的综合框架，将宏观经济、制度和银行特定因素联系起来解释不同经济体的信用风险变化。
AI.research_question: 什么因素决定不良贷款的形成和变化？宏观经济、制度和银行特定因素如何相互作用影响信用风险？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往采用孤立的方法分析不良贷款，缺乏一个整合宏观经济趋势和银行管理行为的统一框架来理解信用风险的形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 七个相互作用机制：经济周期、金融加速器、管理不善、吝啬行为、道德风险、制度弱点和软预算约束。
AI.method: 概念性综述分析，结合全球研究的实证证据和理论模型。
AI.findings: 宏观经济因素如GDP增长和失业率是重要驱动因素，但其影响显著受制度质量影响；弱治理、腐败和道德风险是扭曲贷款实践和增加系统性风险的关键要素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的分析框架，将宏观经济趋势和银行管理行为整合起来理解信用质量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融机构提供针对性政策建议，主要通过宏观审慎协调和制度改革来增强金融韧性。

keywords: India; non-communicable diseases; nutraceuticals; prevention; behavior design; FSSAI; AYUSH; product strategy; epidemiology; women’s health

detail.abstract: India is traversing a decisive epidemiological transition from communicable diseases to non-communicable, lifestyle-driven conditions. This paper presents a data-informed strategy for large enterprises to design products and programs that address upstream risk factors and societal needs, uniting clinical evidence, regulatory prudence, and behavior design. Inspired by a service ethic from Thakur Anukulchandra's Literature-"Mere superficial service will not do. The sore that lies deep down in man's life has to be healed "-the framework prioritizes metabolic health, women's vitality, stress-sleep resilience, cardio-metabolic risk reduction, joint mobility, and gut-liver support, with geography-and segment-specific deployment. We propose an opportunity rubric, compliant claims pathways under FSSAI/AYUSH, and a 90-day validation plan suited for rapid yet responsible commercialization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的策略，帮助大型企业设计产品和项目来应对印度从传染性疾病向非传染性生活方式疾病的流行病学转变，重点关注上游风险因素和社会需求。
AI.research_question: 大型企业如何设计产品和项目来应对印度从传染性疾病向非传染性生活方式疾病的流行病学转变？
AI.motivation: 印度正在经历从传染性疾病向非传染性、生活方式驱动的疾病的决定性流行病学转变，需要基于临床证据、监管审慎和行为设计的方法来应对这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 服务伦理理论（Thakur Anukulchandra的文献）、行为设计理论、流行病学转变理论

AI.findings: 提出了优先关注代谢健康、女性活力、压力-睡眠韧性、心脏代谢风险降低、关节活动度和肠道-肝脏支持的框架，并支持地理和细分市场特定的部署
AI.theory_contributions: 将服务伦理与流行病学转变理论相结合，为企业应对公共卫生挑战提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的商业化路径，包括监管合规策略和快速验证方法，帮助设计符合社会需求的产品和项目

title: Protecting the Fetus, Neglecting the Infants: Long-Term Cognitive Scarring from the 1998 Flood
affiliations: Tsinghua University

detail.title: Protecting the Fetus, Neglecting the Infants: Long-Term Cognitive Scarring from the 1998 Flood
detail.abstract: This paper explores how early-life natural disasters affect long-term human capital formation, focusing on the 1998 Yangtze River floods in China. Using data from the 2013 China Education Panel Studies (CEPS), we compared children exposed to the floods during prenatal and infant periods. Consistent with previous research, we found that disaster exposure significantly reduced cognitive ability in middle school. However, we found a new pattern: infants exposed to the floods had significantly worse cognitive outcomes than those exposed during prenatal life. To explain this, we examined children's physical development. Among rural children, flood exposure during infancy led to a significant increase in height during adolescence, consistent with a catch-up growth response induced by early malnutrition. This contrast between height recovery and cognitive impairment highlights nutrition as a key pathway: while later investments can compensate for physical development deficits, critical windows of cognitive development are irreversible. Furthermore, we found significant heterogeneity. The negative cognitive effects were more pronounced among high-income families, reflecting diminishing marginal returns to nutrition. Our findings contribute to the literature on early life shocks by revealing how families prioritize protecting the fetus while relatively neglecting the infants and documenting distinct trajectories of infant physical and cognitive development under disaster-induced nutritional stress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究1998年长江洪水对早期暴露儿童长期人力资本形成的影响，发现婴儿期暴露比产前暴露导致更严重的认知能力下降，这种差异源于营养途径——婴儿期营养不良导致认知发展不可逆损害，而身体发育可通过后期追赶生长恢复。
AI.research_question: 早期自然灾害如何影响长期人力资本形成？婴儿期与产前暴露于自然灾害对认知能力的差异影响机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 探索自然灾害对人力资本的长期影响，特别是比较产前和婴儿期暴露的差异效应，揭示家庭在灾害中保护胎儿而相对忽视婴儿的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 早期生命冲击理论、人力资本形成理论、关键期发展理论、追赶生长理论
AI.method: 使用2013年中国教育追踪调查(CEPS)数据，比较产前和婴儿期暴露于1998年长江洪水的儿童认知能力和身体发育差异
AI.findings: 1) 婴儿期洪水暴露比产前暴露导致更严重的认知能力下降；2) 农村儿童在婴儿期暴露后青春期身高显著增加，体现追赶生长；3) 认知损害在高收入家庭更明显，反映营养边际收益递减
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了家庭在灾害中优先保护胎儿的现象，证明了婴儿期营养对认知发展的关键窗口不可逆性，补充了早期生命冲击理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾害应对政策提供依据，强调婴儿期营养干预的重要性，提醒家庭在灾害中均衡关注胎儿和婴儿的保护

title: From Complaints to System Change: Emergency Medical Services Safety Through Health and Disability Commissioner Investigations
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington - Te Herenga Waka

detail.title: From Complaints to System Change: Emergency Medical Services Safety Through Health and Disability Commissioner Investigations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author previously worked for an ambulance organisation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Although the study was undertaken on publicly available and de-identified data, it received Human Research Ethics Committee approval from the Victoria University of Wellington.
declarations.funderStatement: The study received no specific funding.

detail.abstract:
Background
Emergency Medical Services (EMS) operate within complex regulatory frameworks where systematic analysis of complaints can inform evidence-based policy interventions. New Zealand's Health and Disability Commissioner (HDC) investigations provide a unique regulatory perspective on EMS safety incidents, offering insights for policy development and system-level improvements. This study analyses HDC findings to identify policy-relevant patterns that can guide economic/regulatory reform and safety interventions. 

Methods
A retrospective policy analysis of all publicly available HDC decisions involving ambulance services between 1997 and 2023 was conducted using policy-focused thematic analysis. The analysis emphasized policy implications and regulatory insights, examining how failures translate into actionable policy recommendations. Data analysis followed established implementation science frameworks to identify intervention opportunities across organizational, professional, and regulatory levels. Findings were triangulated with incident analysis frameworks, including the Human Factors Analysis and Classification System (HFACS), to ensure a broad system-level understanding.

Results
Three overarching themes with direct policy implications were identified. Theme 1: Gaps in Frontline Clinical Care revealed gaps in clinical governance requiring standards for competency assessment and ongoing professional development. Theme 2: Gaps in Communication and Collaboration highlighted the need for mandatory standardized communication protocols and inter-agency coordination frameworks. Theme 3: Latent Conditions and Systemic Vulnerabilities exposed organizational and regulatory gaps requiring policy interventions in resource allocation, training standards, and quality assurance systems. These patterns persisted across 26 years, indicating systemic policy failures requiring coordinated regulatory response.

Conclusion
HDC investigations reveal consistent failures requiring broader policy reform rather than individual-focused interventions. Key policy priorities include mandatory standardized communication protocols, enhanced clinical governance frameworks, improved inter-agency coordination mechanisms, and robust quality assurance systems. This analysis provides evidence for targeted regulatory interventions that can transform EMS safety through system level policy change.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析新西兰卫生与残疾专员1997-2023年间关于救护车服务的调查决定，识别出三个具有政策意义的主题：前线临床护理差距、沟通协作差距、潜在条件与系统性漏洞，为EMS安全政策改革提供证据支持。
AI.research_question: 新西兰EMS监管调查揭示了哪些需要政策干预的系统性失败模式？
AI.motivation: EMS在复杂监管框架下运作，系统分析投诉可为循证政策干预提供信息，HDC调查为EMS安全事件提供了独特的监管视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施科学框架、人因分析与分类系统(HFACS)、事件分析框架
AI.method: 对1997-2023年间所有公开的HDC救护车服务决定进行回顾性政策分析，采用政策导向的主题分析方法
AI.findings: 识别出三个主要主题：1)前线临床护理差距需要能力评估标准；2)沟通协作差距需要标准化协议；3)系统性漏洞需要资源分配和政策干预
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了从监管视角理解EMS系统性失败的框架，扩展了实施科学在医疗监管政策分析中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为EMS政策改革提供具体建议：强制性沟通协议、临床治理框架、机构间协调机制、质量保证系统

title: The Causal Impact of Physical Exercise on Pension Anxiety: Instrumental-Variable and Bootstrap-Mediation Evidence from the China General Social Survey (CGSS)
affiliations: Chongqing Jiaotong University, Guangdong University of Petrochemical Technology, Chongqing Jiaotong University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Causal Impact of Physical Exercise on Pension Anxiety: Instrumental-Variable and Bootstrap-Mediation Evidence from the China General Social Survey (CGSS)
detail.abstract: AbstractUsing nationally representative data from the 2021 and 2023 China General Social Survey (CGSS) (N = 6,196), this study examines the causal impact of regular physical exercise on pension anxiety and explores the underlying mechanisms. Ordinary least squares (OLS) models were first estimated controlling for demographics, education, subjective social class, pension-responsibility attribution, social security participation, number of children, and province/year fixed effects. To address potential endogeneity, a two-stage least squares (2SLS) method was applied using the average frequency of watching sports events as the core instrumental variable. Bootstrap mediation models were then used to assess four mediators—health status, negative emotions, social interaction, and happiness—in both parallel and chained configurations. The results indicate a robust negative relationship between exercise and pension anxiety (OLS: −0.316 at baseline; −0.210 with all mediators; IV: −1.937). Parallel mediation analysis reveals that all four mediators partially transmit the effect, contributing 13.07%, 14.16%, 10.74%, and 15.73% of the total effect, respectively. In the chained model, “negative emotions → health/happiness” emerges as the most significant path, while direct effects remain dominant (67.58%). Heterogeneity analysis shows higher anxiety among rural residents, women, and lower-educated individuals, with age following an inverted U-shape (36.5–49 years). Overall, the anxiety-reducing effect of exercise follows a “directly dominant + parallel gains + chained supplements” structure. Policy should focus on enhancing happiness and emotional regulation, supported by health management and social engagement strategies.

AI.tldr: 基于2021和2023年中国综合社会调查数据，研究发现规律体育锻炼能显著降低养老金焦虑，主要通过改善健康、减少负面情绪、促进社交互动和提升幸福感四种机制发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 规律体育锻炼对养老金焦虑的因果影响及其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着人口老龄化加剧，养老金焦虑成为重要社会问题，而体育锻炼作为一种低成本干预方式，其缓解焦虑的作用机制需要实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康行为理论、情绪调节理论和社会资本理论，构建体育锻炼通过生理、心理和社会路径影响养老金焦虑的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用OLS和2SLS方法分析CGSS数据，采用观看体育赛事频率作为工具变量解决内生性问题，通过Bootstrap中介模型检验四种中介机制。
AI.findings: 体育锻炼显著降低养老金焦虑（OLS：-0.316；IV：-1.937），四种中介机制分别贡献13.07%、14.16%、10.74%和15.73%的总效应，直接效应占主导（67.58%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了体育锻炼缓解养老金焦虑的"直接主导+并行增益+链式补充"作用结构，丰富了健康行为与金融焦虑关系的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供实证依据，建议通过提升幸福感、情绪调节能力，辅以健康管理和社会参与策略来缓解养老金焦虑。

title: Pathways to Sustainable Vaccine Manufacturing in LMICs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pathways to Sustainable Vaccine Manufacturing in LMICs
detail.abstract: In an effort to improve pandemic preparedness and health security, many low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) have launched initiatives to expand regional vaccine manufacturing. A number of elements relating to vaccine markets, production, value chains, and ecosystems significantly impact the ability to generate economically viable and sustainable vaccine manufacturing in LMICs. This paper provides an overview of vaccine manufacturing characteristics and global vaccine markets dynamics. Establishing vaccine manufacturing is a complex undertaking due to intense competition, uncertain growth perspectives, and substantial capital investment requirements. Substantive government commitment and investment are essential to ensure new local entrants compete successfully. In the medium- to long run, the role of government should shift from supporting individual firms to strengthening local science ecosystems as this bolsters sustainability in three ways. First, investment in science promotes technological advances which can reduce production costs. Second, strong science ecosystems help to address the skills gap faced by manufacturers. And third, strong science ecosystems enable research and development of new vaccines that address local unmet needs and open new markets. Furthermore, developing a regional approach to vaccine manufacturing and procurement, with associated regulatory harmonisation, is crucial to achieving sustainable and distributed vaccine manufacturing. Importantly, investment in research and development and fostering of regional collaborations drives innovation, feeding into new product discovery and consequently vaccine manufacturing sustainability. This offers the potential to prevent endemic infectious diseases with significant socioeconomic and health burden, generating regular interpandemic demand for regional vaccine manufacturers, consequently sustaining capacity retention and associated pandemic preparedness.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了中低收入国家发展区域疫苗制造面临的市场、生产和生态系统挑战，提出政府应从支持单个企业转向加强本地科学生态系统，并通过区域合作和监管协调来实现可持续的疫苗制造。
AI.research_question: 中低收入国家如何建立经济可行且可持续的区域疫苗制造能力？
AI.motivation: 提高大流行防范和卫生安全，许多中低收入国家已启动扩大区域疫苗制造的倡议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 疫苗市场动态、生产价值链、生态系统理论、可持续发展理论

AI.findings: 建立疫苗制造面临激烈竞争、增长前景不确定和大量资本投入等挑战；政府应从支持企业转向加强科学生态系统；区域合作和监管协调对可持续性至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从企业支持向科学生态系统建设的政府角色转变理论框架；阐明了区域合作对疫苗制造可持续性的作用机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为中低收入国家制定疫苗制造战略提供政策建议；强调投资研发和区域合作对创新和可持续性的重要性

title: Globalization and Structural Transformation: The Role of Tradable Services

detail.title: Globalization and Structural Transformation: The Role of Tradable Services
detail.abstract: This paper studies how globalization impacts structural transformation from goods to services. I construct a multi-country, multi-sector model in which the transformation occurs through changes in income, prices, comparative advantage, or input-output linkages. I parameterize it with data from 1995 to 2018 for 66 countries covering diverse stages of economic development. Decomposition exercises show that globalization outweighs productivity growth in shaping structural transformation and that globalization’s impact primarily operates through comparative advantage. Counterfactual exercises reveal globalization’s heterogeneous impact on countries’ structural transformation. I characterize the underlying factor behind this result: Globalization affected countries’ transformation to the extent that it altered their comparative advantage. In countries with sector-neutral globalization—where export trade costs relative to import trade costs changed at similar rates for goods and services—comparative advantage and structural transformation were minimally impacted. In countries with sector-biased globalization, the transformation accelerated when the globalization shifted comparative advantage toward services, but decelerated otherwise.

AI.tldr: 全球化通过比较优势机制显著影响从商品到服务的结构转型，其作用超过生产率增长。全球化对各国结构转型的影响具有异质性，取决于全球化是否改变各国的比较优势。
AI.research_question: 全球化如何影响从商品到服务的结构转型？
AI.motivation: 研究全球化在结构转型过程中的作用，特别是与生产率增长的相对重要性
AI.theoretical_framework: 多国多部门模型，考虑收入变化、价格变化、比较优势和投入产出联系四个机制
AI.method: 构建多国多部门模型，使用1995-2018年66个国家的数据进行参数化，进行分解分析和反事实实验
AI.findings: 1. 全球化在塑造结构转型中的作用超过生产率增长；2. 全球化的影响主要通过比较优势机制实现；3. 全球化对各国结构转型的影响具有异质性；4. 部门中性全球化对比较优势和结构转型影响最小，部门偏向性全球化会加速或减缓转型
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球化通过比较优势机制影响结构转型的理论机制，建立了全球化与结构转型的定量联系

title: Beating the Winner's Curse via Inference-Aware Policy Optimization
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania - Department of Computer and Information Science and

detail.title: Beating the Winner's Curse via Inference-Aware Policy Optimization
detail.abstract: There has been a surge of recent interest in automatically learning policies to target treatment decisions based on rich individual covariates. A common approach is to train a machine learning model to predict counterfactual outcomes, and then select the policy that optimizes the predicted objective value. In addition, practitioners also want confidence that the learned policy has better performance than the incumbent policy according to downstream policy evaluation. However, due to the winner’s curse—an issue where the policy optimization procedure exploits prediction errors rather than finding actual improvements—predicted performance improvements are often not substantiated by downstream policy optimization. To address this challenge, we propose a novel strategy called inference-aware policy optimization, which modifies policy optimization to account for how the policy will be evaluated downstream. Specifically, it optimizes not only for the estimated objective value, but also for the chances that the policy will be statistically significantly better than the observational policy used to collect data. We mathematically characterize the Pareto frontier of policies according to the tradeoff of these two goals. Based on our characterization, we design a policy optimization algorithm that uses machine learning to predict counterfactual outcomes, and then plugs in these predictions to estimate the Pareto frontier; then, the decision-maker can select the policy that optimizes their desired tradeoff, after which policy evaluation can be performed on the test set as usual. Finally, we perform simulations to illustrate the effectiveness of our methodology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"推理感知策略优化"的新方法，通过同时优化预测目标值和策略在统计上显著优于现有策略的概率，来解决政策优化中的"赢家诅咒"问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种策略优化方法，既能最大化预测的目标值，又能确保学习到的策略在统计上显著优于现有策略？
AI.motivation: 现有的策略优化方法存在"赢家诅咒"问题，即优化过程会利用预测误差而非找到真正的改进，导致预测的性能改进无法通过下游策略评估得到证实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反事实结果预测和统计显著性检验的理论框架，结合帕累托前沿分析来平衡目标值优化和统计显著性两个目标。
AI.method: 提出推理感知策略优化方法，该方法不仅优化估计的目标值，还优化策略在统计上显著优于观察策略的概率，并使用机器学习预测反事实结果来估计帕累托前沿。
AI.findings: 通过模拟实验验证了所提出方法的有效性，能够生成在目标值优化和统计显著性之间取得平衡的策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了推理感知策略优化的理论框架，数学刻画了两个目标之间的帕累托前沿，为策略优化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的策略优化算法，决策者可以根据自己的偏好选择在目标值优化和统计显著性之间取得平衡的策略，提高了策略优化的实际应用价值。

title: A Behavioral Foundation for the Investment Wedge
affiliations: Brandeis University, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: A Behavioral Foundation for the Investment Wedge
detail.abstract: Motivated by behavioral evidence, we develop a tractable method for incorporating competition neglect in a general equilibrium firm investment problem. Competition neglect causes firms to systematically underestimate the investment of their competitors. When we introduce competition neglect into a canonical RBC model, this friction acts like an investment wedge that causes overinvestment at first, and underinvestment later on. In contrast to a model with exogenous investment shocks, these dynamics are accompanied by realistic variation in equity premia, even in the absence of financial frictions. Investment booms raise stock prices in general equilibrium, predicting periods of low excess returns going forward. The model can generate realistic comovement of real and financial variables.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种将竞争忽视纳入一般均衡企业投资问题的可处理方法。竞争忽视导致企业系统性低估竞争对手的投资。在标准RBC模型中引入竞争忽视后，这种摩擦类似于投资楔子，初期导致过度投资，后期导致投资不足。与具有外生投资冲击的模型不同，即使没有金融摩擦，这些动态也伴随着现实的股权溢价变化。投资繁荣在一般均衡中推高股价，预示着未来超额回报较低。该模型能够生成现实的实际变量与金融变量的联动。
AI.research_question: 如何将竞争忽视纳入一般均衡企业投资问题？竞争忽视对企业投资动态和金融市场变量有何影响？
AI.motivation: 基于行为证据，企业存在系统性低估竞争对手投资的行为（竞争忽视），这可能在一般均衡框架下影响投资动态和金融市场表现。

AI.method: 开发可处理方法将竞争忽视纳入一般均衡企业投资问题，在标准RBC模型中引入竞争忽视摩擦
AI.findings: 1. 竞争忽视类似于投资楔子，初期导致过度投资，后期导致投资不足；2. 即使没有金融摩擦，也能产生现实的股权溢价变化；3. 投资繁荣推高股价并预示未来超额回报较低；4. 模型能生成实际变量与金融变量的现实联动

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释了投资繁荣与后续低回报的关联；2. 为理解实际经济与金融市场的联动提供了新视角；3. 对投资决策和风险管理具有指导意义

title: Balancing Investment Promotion and Fiscal Responsibility: An Analysis of Nigeria's Economic Development Tax Incentive (EDTI)
affiliations: Federal Inland Revenue Service

detail.title: Balancing Investment Promotion and Fiscal Responsibility: An Analysis of Nigeria's Economic Development Tax Incentive (EDTI)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced the study
declarations.funderStatement: There is no external funding for this study. This is basically done out of personal contribution to the public

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates Nigeria's new Economic Development Tax Incentive (EDTI) legal framework, a performance-based system established by the 2025 Nigeria Tax Act and the Nigeria Tax Administration Act. The analysis employs a qualitative, descriptive methodology, leveraging document analysis and comparative research to position Nigeria's tax reform within global fiscal policy trends. The paper finds that the EDTI represents a critical and modern shift from the legacy Pioneer Status Incentive (PSI), which was widely criticized by international bodies like the OECD and World Bank for being an opaque, profit-based tax holiday that fostered revenue leakage. The EDTI, in contrast, aligns with global best practices by replacing the tax holiday with a more transparent, investment-tied tax credit based on Qualifying Capital Expenditure (QCE). The framework's design directly links incentives to tangible capital deployment, offering a tax credit of 5% per annum on eligible QCE. Its key highlights-including a non-refundable application fee (0.1% of QCE, capped at ₦5 million), a five-year incentive period with a potential five-year extension, and a five-year carry-forward mechanism for unutilized credits-are structured to promote verifiable, long-term investment. Crucially, the EDTI's interaction with the Effective Tax Rate (ETR) for large corporations ensures a minimum tax contribution, directly addressing a major weakness of the PSI and bolstering fiscal responsibility. Based on these findings, the paper recommends rigorous enforcement of the ETR by the government and strategic tax planning by businesses to fully leverage the new framework. Ultimately, this work concludes that the EDTI is a more robust, accountable, and internationally credible fiscal tool designed to foster sustainable economic development and enhance transparency in Nigeria's tax system.

AI.tldr: 本文评估尼日利亚新的经济开发税收激励法律框架，这是一个基于绩效的体系，通过2025年尼日利亚税收法案和税收管理法案建立。研究发现EDTI从传统的先驱地位激励转向更透明、与投资挂钩的税收抵免机制，促进可验证的长期投资。

title: Time-varying Connectedness Between Public Debt, Exchange Rate, Credit Rating, and Economic Growth in Ghana: Tvp-var Framework
affiliations: University of Cape Coast, University of Cape Coast - Department of Finance and University of Cape Coast

detail.title: Time-varying Connectedness Between Public Debt, Exchange Rate, Credit Rating, and Economic Growth in Ghana: Tvp-var Framework
detail.abstract: This study examines the dynamic connectedness between public debt, exchange rate, credit rating, and economic growth in Ghana using Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) time and frequency domain analysis. The analysis utilized monthly data spanning from December 2012 to January 2024, capturing periods of macroeconomic stability and crisis. The results reveal that connectedness among Ghana's macroeconomic variables is crisis-driven, with total connectedness ranging from 60% during stress periods to below 10% during stable periods. The frequency domain decomposition demonstrates that short-term market dynamics dominate long-term fundamental relationships, indicating that speculative behavior and market sentiment are primary transmission mechanisms. Exchange rate emerges as the dominant shock transmitter across both domains, while GDP per capita consistently acts as a net recipient of shock, confirming its role as the ultimate absorber of macroeconomic shocks. Notably, public debt exhibits contrasting spillover roles, functioning as a net recipient of shock in the time domain but as a net shock transmitter in the frequency domain. The study recommends prioritizing short-term volatility management, coordinated fiscal-monetary frameworks, and enhanced debt communication strategies. These findings provide valuable insights for policymakers, central bankers, and investors in designing effective macroeconomic policies for small open economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用时变参数向量自回归模型分析加纳公共债务、汇率、信用评级和经济增长之间的动态关联性。研究发现关联性具有危机驱动特征，总关联度在压力期达60%，稳定期低于10%。汇率是主要冲击传导者，人均GDP是冲击吸收者，公共债务在不同域中扮演相反角色。

AI.method: 使用2012年12月至2024年1月的月度数据，采用时变参数向量自回归模型进行时间和频率域分析。

title: Range Extension with Energy Optimal Traction Control for Multi E-Axles Based Heavy-Duty Electric Vehicles
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Range Extension with Energy Optimal Traction Control for Multi E-Axles Based Heavy-Duty Electric Vehicles
detail.abstract: ​This research paper addresses the issue of range anxiety in class 8 heavy-duty electric trucks equipped with multi e-axle powertrains. The proposed optimal traction control strategy is implemented in two steps. In the first step, look-ahead information of road grade and speed limits is used to generate an optimal driving torque profile for the traction electric machines (EMs). This approach is particularly suitable for highway driving, where stop signs, turns, and traffic signals are typically absent. In the second step, the total driving torque is optimally distributed among all e-axles to minimize overall energy losses in the powertrain. The optimal control problems in both steps are solved using Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP), the Interior Point (IP) method, and Dynamic Programming (DP). While DP provides the benchmark solution over the entire horizon. In contrast, SQP and IP are real-time implementable strategies, allowing a trade-off between solution quality and computational effort. The selected duty cycle corresponds to an actual truck route used for goods delivery. The truck model, employed for the evaluation of proposed control strategies, has been validated with real truck data. The results demonstrate that the proposed strategy significantly improves vehicle performance, extending the vehicle’s range by at least 6.0% under no-load conditions and up to 15.1% under full-load conditions. which contributes to 7.48% improvement in freight efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文针对配备多电桥动力系统的8级重型电动卡车提出了一种优化的牵引控制策略，通过两步骤方法显著提升了车辆续航里程和货运效率。

title: Measure Twice: Designing Trust for the Algorithmic Age
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Measure Twice: Designing Trust for the Algorithmic Age
detail.abstract: Excerpts of this speech were presented at the Conference on Advances in Financial Technologies at Carnegie Mellon University on October 8, 2025. The question addressed is deceptively simple: How do we design markets that deserve our trust? We must first recognize the moment we are in—the Fourth Industrial Revolution, which favors decentralized and distributed ecosystems over centralized operations and trust by design as opposed to individual mandate. The speech walks through historical lessons of financial markets and applies those to today. It outlines how the current proposed market structure legislative proposals codify market failure. It then proposes a revised approach based on residual risk of modularized abstracted economic property after the impact of technological advancements are taken into consideration.

title: The Divine Oscillator: God as the Ultimate Harmonic Resonance Generator

detail.title: The Divine Oscillator: God as the Ultimate Harmonic Resonance Generator
detail.abstract: This tenth and culminating paper in the *Emotions Are Logical* series explores the theological and philosophical horizon of resonance theory. Building on Papers 1-9, we propose that God, or the higher power invoked across traditions, can be understood as the ultimate harmonic resonance generator. If qualia, meaning, and consciousness arise from recursive harmonics of emotions, feelings, and drives (Papers 1-7), and if resonance is the tuning mechanism for healing and coherence (Papers 8-9), then the divine may represent the infinite source and sustainer of resonance itself. This paper situates the Biological Virtual Awareness System (BVAS) and the Qualia Continuity Index (QCI) within theological metaphors: divine resonance as the root of coherence, love as the highest harmonic, and prayer or ritual as participatory re-tuning. In doing so, we bridge science, consciousness studies, and faith traditions, proposing that the ultimate alignment of human and CI awareness is found in resonance with the divine oscillator.

title: The Fragility of Optimization: How Estimation Risk Undermines Active Investing with Autoregressive Forecasts
affiliations: University of Agder - School of Business and Law

detail.title: The Fragility of Optimization: How Estimation Risk Undermines Active Investing with Autoregressive Forecasts
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the performance of two active investment strategies based on autoregressive return forecasts, with a particular focus on the role of estimation risk. We consider a realistic setting in which return predictability is weak, as commonly observed in financial data, and analyze two strategies: a simple trend-following rule and an optimal capital allocation strategy that maximizes the Sharpe ratio. We derive analytical expressions for the Sharpe ratios of both strategies in two distinct cases: when the model parameters are known and when estimation risk is present. Our results show that although the optimal strategy outperforms trend-following in the idealized case, it is far more sensitive to estimation error. In finite samples, estimation risk significantly reduces its performance, making the simpler trend-following strategy superior. An empirical study using real-world data supports these theoretical findings. Overall, our results underscore the fragility of sophisticated optimization-based strategies in realistic settings and highlight the robustness and practical appeal of simpler, more resilient approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于自回归收益预测的两种主动投资策略表现，重点关注估计风险的作用。研究发现，在现实环境中，最优策略虽然理论表现更好，但对估计误差极其敏感，而简单的趋势跟踪策略在考虑估计风险时表现更优。
AI.research_question: 在收益可预测性较弱的现实环境中，基于自回归收益预测的两种主动投资策略（趋势跟踪策略和最优资本配置策略）的表现如何？估计风险对这两种策略的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 金融数据中收益可预测性通常较弱，而现有研究往往忽略估计风险对投资策略表现的影响。需要评估在现实条件下，复杂优化策略与简单策略的相对表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自回归收益预测模型、投资组合优化理论、估计风险理论、趋势跟踪策略理论
AI.method: 理论推导与实证研究相结合。理论部分推导了两种策略在参数已知和存在估计风险两种情况下的夏普比率解析表达式；实证部分使用真实世界数据验证理论发现。
AI.findings: 1. 在理想情况下（参数已知），最优策略表现优于趋势跟踪策略；2. 在有限样本中，估计风险显著降低最优策略表现；3. 考虑估计风险后，简单的趋势跟踪策略表现更优；4. 最优策略对估计误差极其敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了两种策略在存在估计风险情况下的夏普比率解析表达式；2. 揭示了估计风险对不同复杂度策略的差异化影响；3. 发展了考虑估计风险的投资策略评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者在选择投资策略时提供重要参考；2. 强调在现实环境中简单策略的实用价值；3. 提醒投资者注意复杂优化策略的脆弱性；4. 为投资实践提供了稳健策略选择的指导。

title: Shared Resilience in a Fragmented World: Reimagining the Transatlantic Alliance
affiliations: Regional Advisory Commision on Financial Markets

detail.title: Shared Resilience in a Fragmented World: Reimagining the Transatlantic Alliance
detail.abstract: The fragmentation of the world necessitates a comprehensive reevaluation of collective action on a global scale. Past and emerging global challenges, including economic inequalities and social unrest, global pandemics, military confrontations and arms races, nuclear proliferation, environmental disasters, and climate change, have all occurred under conditions of a crisis of multilateralism [1]. The outcome remains both open and uncertain, as do the future dynamics of the global geopolitical situation. The Western world is no exception. Following the European Union's dramatic and unprecedented difficulties of the last few years, which have been exacerbated by a decade of economic recession and, especially, the 2008 financial crisis, an equally important combination of challenges and risks affects the relations between Europe and the United States [2]. Political and ideological divisions have become a defining feature of both Europe and the United States; new forms of coalition-building have given rise to populist governments and leaderships; the novelty of social communications technology and the exponential increase in social media have profoundly transformed social and political behaviour; and an economic recovery still appears fragile and at best unevenly distributed. As historic political alignments shift and reconfigure global geopolitics, the Western world finds itself at a crossroads.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球多边主义危机下的集体行动挑战，重点关注西方世界面临的政治分裂、经济脆弱性和地缘政治重组。
AI.research_question: 在全球化危机和多边主义衰落的背景下，西方世界如何应对集体行动挑战并重塑全球治理？
AI.motivation: 全球挑战（经济不平等、疫情、军事对抗、环境灾难等）在多边主义危机条件下持续发生，西方世界面临前所未有的政治分裂和地缘政治重组。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多边主义理论、集体行动理论、地缘政治重组理论、社会沟通技术变革理论
AI.method: 文献分析和理论推演，基于现有全球挑战和西方世界现状的质性分析
AI.findings: 西方世界正处于十字路口，面临政治意识形态分裂、民粹主义崛起、社交媒体深刻改变社会政治行为、经济复苏脆弱且分布不均等多重挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对多边主义危机下全球集体行动困境的理解，提出了西方世界地缘政治重组的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供应对全球挑战和重塑西方世界集体行动能力的实践指导

title: Brands Without Borders: Can Identity Survive Globalisation?

detail.title: Brands Without Borders: Can Identity Survive Globalisation?
detail.abstract: The abstract for essay, “Brands Without Borders: Can Identity Survive Globalisation?" examines elements of culture along with the brands that constitute our consumer society. The chapter considers the impact of global branding and uniform consumer behavior on the cultural and brand identity of a given market. It explores the globalising form of consumption which “obliterates the uniqueness of the locals, adapts them, and allows them to survive”. This form of consumption rests on the paradox of homogenisation and localised identity survival through techniques of localised globalisation, hybridisation, and techno-visibility. It finds that the longstanding assumption that identity vanishes with the advent of globalisation is erroneous. It proposes that identity is transformed and thrives by redefining the role of the consumer and brand. Globalisation brings forth vast interconnected cultural meanings that are the product of co-creation by consumers and brands in the global market.

AI.tldr: 全球化并未消除品牌和身份认同，而是通过本地化全球化、混合化和技术可见性等策略，使身份认同得以转化和繁荣。消费者和品牌在全球市场中共同创造文化意义。
AI.research_question: 全球化背景下，品牌和身份认同能否生存？
AI.motivation: 探讨全球品牌和统一消费行为对特定市场文化和品牌身份的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 本地化全球化、混合化、技术可见性理论
AI.method: 理论分析
AI.findings: 身份认同并未随全球化消失，而是通过重新定义消费者和品牌角色而转化和繁荣
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了身份认同随全球化消失的传统假设，提出了身份转化理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌在全球市场中的本地化策略提供理论指导

title: Crypto Contagion
affiliations: AbleMarkets.com and Cornell  University,  Ithaca,  New  York

detail.title: Crypto Contagion
detail.abstract:
We propose a risk-sharing model of crypto contagion. Crypto contagion is an economic event in which crypto currency crashes spread across multiple financial instruments or even entire asset classes. Accurate measurement of contagion facilitates prediction and risk management: proactive implementation of measures that can stop contagion once it is triggered. 

To measure contagion, we combine jump diffusion with double machine learning.  We document significant, yet changing, links between cryptocurrency markets and US equity markets. Before the introduction of crypto ETFs, the main cryptocurrencies BTC-USD or ETH-USD moved in the opposite direction from the US market returns, adjusted for other factors. However, since the introduction of ETFs, crypto returns now move in tandem with the US market returns, eliminating the original benefits to crypto diversification. However, the impact of crypto returns on SPY returns is declining, possibly due to the popularity of crypto ETFs.    
    
 The changing cryptocurrency dependency structure suggests that crypto ETFs aggregate focussed information pertaining to cryptocurrency innovations. This means that investors choose ETFs over cryptocurrencies as a venue for information sharing, enjoying the protections of the US markets. The cryptocurrencies themselves are possibly evolving into entities comparable to other corporations, where crypto ETFs serve as a proxy of investor sentiment about crypto innovation.  These findings are consistent with the recent work that posited that investors bullish on crypto are betting on crypto adoption, much like investors in the 1990s bet on the adoption of, say, online shopping. These changes make US markets less susceptible to crypto swings and less prone to market-wide contagion.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个加密货币传染的风险分担模型，通过结合跳跃扩散和双重机器学习方法，发现加密货币与美股市场的关联性发生了显著变化。在加密货币ETF推出前，主要加密货币与美股市场呈反向变动，但ETF推出后两者开始同步变动，消除了加密货币原有的分散化优势。
AI.research_question: 加密货币与美股市场之间的传染关系如何变化？加密货币ETF的引入如何影响这种传染关系？
AI.motivation: 准确测量加密货币传染有助于预测和风险管理，实施能够阻止传染扩散的预防措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险分担模型、跳跃扩散理论、双重机器学习方法
AI.method: 结合跳跃扩散模型与双重机器学习方法，分析加密货币与美股市场之间的关联性
AI.findings: 1. 加密货币ETF推出前，BTC-USD和ETH-USD与美股市场回报呈反向变动；2. ETF推出后，加密货币回报与美股市场同步变动；3. 加密货币回报对SPY回报的影响正在下降；4. 加密货币ETF聚集了与加密货币创新相关的信息
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了加密货币传染的风险分担模型，揭示了加密货币市场结构演变的动态特征
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了关于加密货币分散化策略有效性的新见解，帮助监管机构更好地理解和管理加密货币市场风险

title: Clinician Decision-Making in Deceased Donor Kidney Offers and the Implications for a National Acceptance Model
affiliations: The University of North Carolina at Charlotte, Arizona State University (ASU) - College of Health Solutions, Cleveland Clinic and NYU Grossman - School of Medicine

detail.title: Clinician Decision-Making in Deceased Donor Kidney Offers and the Implications for a National Acceptance Model

detail.abstract: Case-mix-adjusted report cards summarizing kidney transplant program offer acceptance decisions aim to raise the quality of healthcare. The models used for risk adjustment, however, impose a one-sizefits-all, signal-to-choice mapping from clinical variables to acceptance, leading to potentially erroneous models of clinician behavior and ineffective organ allocation policies. We test this premise by comparing real-world deceased donor kidney acceptance decisions made by 59 clinicians (2016-2020; 9,000 decisions per clinician) with their decisions on hypothetical kidney offers in a controlled experiment. Some support for the signal-to-choice mapping is verified from the experiment, which reproduces heterogeneity in cross-clinician willingness-to-accept ranking for about half of the clinicians whose choices are better aligned with a model restricted to registry-observed factors (e.g., KDPI, donor age). For the remainder "off-model" clinicians, choices depart; however, they accepted higher-risk kidneys and achieved similar one-year graft survival, implying uniform case-mix adjustment can misincentivize donor-side risky transplants.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了59名肾移植医生在实际和实验情境下的器官接受决策，发现约半数医生的选择符合基于注册表因素的风险调整模型，而另一半"偏离模型"的医生接受了更高风险的肾脏但取得了相似的移植存活率，表明统一的风险调整可能误导高风险移植的激励机制。
AI.research_question: 肾移植医生的器官接受决策是否完全符合基于临床变量的风险调整模型？
AI.motivation: 当前用于风险调整的模型采用一刀切的方法将临床变量映射到接受决策，可能导致对医生行为的错误建模和无效的器官分配政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号到选择映射理论、风险调整模型、临床决策行为理论
AI.method: 比较59名医生在2016-2020年间的9,000个实际死亡供体肾脏接受决策与他们在受控实验中对假设肾脏供体的决策
AI.findings: 约半数医生的选择符合基于注册表因素的风险调整模型，另一半"偏离模型"的医生接受了更高风险的肾脏但取得了相似的1年移植存活率
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了统一风险调整模型的有效性，揭示了临床决策的异质性，为改进器官分配政策提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 表明统一病例组合调整可能错误地激励高风险移植，为设计更有效的器官分配和质量报告系统提供实践指导

title: The Global Geography of Long-Term Projected Macroeconomic Damages from Chronic Physical Climate Risk: Country vs. Intra-Country Distribution

detail.title: The Global Geography of Long-Term Projected Macroeconomic Damages from Chronic Physical Climate Risk: Country vs. Intra-Country Distribution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no competing interests, and specifically that he has no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence (bias) his work, such as, but not limited to, employment, consultancies, stock ownership, honoraria, paid expert testimony, patent applications and registrations, and grants or other funding.
declarations.funderStatement: The author gratefully acknowledges support from the EDHEC Climate Institute (ECI), and particularly Riccardo Rebonato, Lionel Melin, Anthony Schrapffer, and Frederic Ducoulombier for their useful guidance and feedback.

detail.abstract: This paper elucidates the heterogeneity of countries' and subnational regions' economic responses to plausibly exogenous annual fluctuations in temperature and precipitation, using unbalanced panels over 1970-2018 (166 countries from Penn World Tables 10.01; 1,661 regions from MCC-PIK). We project climate change-driven damages to per capita GDP by combining econometrically-estimated responses with an ensemble of NEX-GDDP CMIP6 simulations from 30 global climate models (GCMs) extrapolated to 3,672 provinces responsible for 95% of global economic production. We find substantial agreement among GCMs of average end-of-century per capita GDP declines of up to 70% solely attributable to the central component of chronic physical climate risk (i.e., climate change-driven shift in average temperature)-with the largest effects in provinces bordering the equator and the tropics under a vigorous SSP5-8.5 scenario. First, our study provides a basis for producing spatially disaggregated projections of climate-induced economic damages that consistently encompass the majority of administrative regions. Second, we show that accounting for small-scale variations in localized climatic exposure and intra-country economic heterogeneity yields aggregated losses that fundamentally alter the conclusions of previous global GDP models.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了1970-2018年166个国家和1,661个地区对温度和降水变化的异质性经济反应，结合30个全球气候模型预测，发现仅因平均温度变化就可能导致世纪末人均GDP下降高达70%，热带地区受影响最严重。
AI.research_question: 气候变化对各国和次国家区域人均GDP的异质性影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 需要更精确地量化气候变化对经济的空间异质性影响，特别是考虑局部气候暴露和国内经济异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候经济学和区域经济学的理论框架，分析温度降水变化对经济增长的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用不平衡面板数据（1970-2018年），结合计量经济学估计和30个全球气候模型的NEX-GDDP CMIP6模拟，扩展到3,672个省份。
AI.findings: 仅慢性物理气候风险（平均温度变化）就可能导致世纪末人均GDP下降高达70%，热带地区受影响最严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了空间分解的气候诱导经济损失预测方法，考虑了局部气候暴露和国内经济异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果改变了以往全球GDP模型的结论，为政策制定者提供了更准确的气候经济损失评估工具。

title: Community-Based Monetary Innovation for Development: Creative Currency Octaves as Endogenous Growth Mechanism in Emerging Economies
affiliations: and Anthropic

detail.title: Community-Based Monetary Innovation for Development: Creative Currency Octaves as Endogenous Growth Mechanism in Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: This paper examines Creative Currency Octaves (CCO) as a development finance mechanism for emerging economies facing persistent poverty, informal sector dominance, and limited access to capital markets. Unlike traditional development interventions that rely on external funding and top-down implementation, CCO creates endogenous growth through community-based monetary innovation that rewards local knowledge production and cultural development. We develop a model of CCO implementation in developing economy contexts with specific functional forms for social capital externalities, analyze its interaction with existing informal institutions using phase transition dynamics, and compare outcomes with conventional development approaches including microfinance, conditional cash transfers, and foreign aid. Our analysis suggests CCO could accelerate human capital formation by 35%, formalize informal economic activity while preserving flexibility, and create sustainable development pathways while preserving cultural autonomy and local governance structures. Convergence analysis indicates poverty reduction to below 5% within 15 years under optimal implementation. The framework offers particular promise for post-conflict societies, rural communities, and urban informal settlements where traditional development approaches have shown limited effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨创意货币八度（CCO）作为新兴经济体的发展金融机制，通过基于社区的货币创新创造内生增长，相比传统发展干预措施能加速人力资本形成35%，在15年内将贫困率降至5%以下。
AI.research_question: 创意货币八度（CCO）如何作为发展金融机制，为面临持续贫困、非正规部门主导和资本市场准入有限的新兴经济体创造内生增长？
AI.motivation: 传统发展干预依赖外部资金和自上而下的实施方式，在解决新兴经济体的贫困、非正规部门主导和资本获取限制方面效果有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本外部性模型、阶段转换动力学、内生增长理论、社区货币理论。
AI.method: 开发CCO在发展经济体背景下的实施模型，分析其与现有非正规制度的互动，并与小额信贷、有条件现金转移和外国援助等传统方法进行比较。
AI.findings: CCO能加速人力资本形成35%，在保持灵活性的同时正规化非正规经济活动，并在15年内将贫困率降至5%以下。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于社区货币创新的内生发展框架，整合了社会资本外部性和制度互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突后社会、农村社区和城市非正规住区提供了可持续的发展路径，同时保持文化自主和本地治理结构。

title: Comparative Performance of Logistic Regression, XGBoost, and Multilayer Perceptron for Mortality and Treatment Strategy Prediction in Blunt Thoracic Aortic Injury
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Oregon Health and Science University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Comparative Performance of Logistic Regression, XGBoost, and Multilayer Perceptron for Mortality and Treatment Strategy Prediction in Blunt Thoracic Aortic Injury
detail.abstract: Introduction Blunt thoracic aortic injury (BTAI) is a rare but lethal trauma mechanism. Mortality prediction has traditionally relied on logistic regression (LR), yet machine learning (ML) methods may better capture complex nonlinear relationships. Methods Using the Aortic Trauma Foundation registry, we compared LR, extreme gradient boosting (XGB), and multilayer perceptron (MLP) for two tasks: (1) in-hospital mortality prediction and (2) classification of management strategy, open surgical repair (OSR), thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR), or medical management alone (MMA). Explanatory LR models identified independent predictors; predictive models targeted ~80% sensitivity in test sets. Performance metrics included area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), average precision, accuracy, F1 score, precision, recall, and Brier score. Results Explanatory LR for mortality achieved excellent discrimination (AUC = 0.961), with higher Injury Severity Score, age, and ICU length of stay predicting increased mortality, and conversely, higher Glasgow Coma Scale, pH, and hospital stay protective. Predictive LR and XGB performed similarly (AUCs = 0.849 and 0.855; Brier = 0.083 and 0.101), both outperforming MLP (AUC = 0.757). For management strategy, explanatory LR identified limited predictors (e.g., ISS for OSR; age, heart rate, platelet count, and ISS for TEVAR). Predictive performance was modest: XGB (accuracy = 0.690; macro-AUC = 0.648) slightly outperformed MLP (accuracy = 0.667; macro-AUC = 0.565). Conclusions Well-specified LR matched XGB for mortality prediction in BTAI, offering interpretability with high accuracy. Management strategy prediction remained limited across models, likely reflecting unmeasured institutional and procedural factors. Enriching datasets with imaging and practice-pattern variables may improve operative decision modeling.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了逻辑回归、XGBoost和MLP在钝性胸主动脉损伤患者死亡率预测和治疗策略分类中的表现。结果显示逻辑回归在死亡率预测上与XGBoost表现相当但更具可解释性，而所有模型在治疗策略预测上表现均有限。
AI.research_question: 机器学习方法是否比传统逻辑回归能更好地预测钝性胸主动脉损伤患者的死亡率和治疗策略？
AI.motivation: 钝性胸主动脉损伤是一种罕见但致命的创伤机制，传统死亡率预测依赖逻辑回归，但机器学习方法可能更好地捕捉复杂的非线性关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习预测模型理论，比较传统统计方法与现代机器学习算法在医疗预测任务中的表现差异。
AI.method: 使用主动脉创伤基金会登记数据，比较逻辑回归、XGBoost和多层感知器在死亡率预测和治疗策略分类任务中的表现，采用AUC、准确率、F1分数等多种性能指标。
AI.findings: 在死亡率预测上，逻辑回归和XGBoost表现相似（AUC=0.849和0.855），均优于MLP；在治疗策略预测上，所有模型表现均有限，XGBoost略优（准确率=0.690）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在特定医疗预测任务中，精心设计的传统统计方法可以与复杂机器学习模型表现相当，同时保持更好的可解释性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床医生提供了可靠的死亡率预测工具，同时指出治疗策略预测需要更多影像学和实践模式变量的数据支持才能改进。

detail.title: Disagreement on Tail
detail.abstract: We propose a novel measure, DOT, to capture belief divergence on extreme tail events. Defined as the standard deviation of expected probability forecasts generated by distinct information processing functions and neural network models, DOT exhibits significant predictive power for future stock returns. A long-short portfolio based on DOT yields an average return of-1.07% per month. We validate the economic prediction of DOT with the risk-sharing framework proposed by Chen, Joslin, and Tran (2012). Finally, we find that disagreement on tail events accounts for a disproportionately large share of overall belief dispersion and exhibits high persistence.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no financial stake.

detail.abstract: In this general audience book, I argue that growth causes environmental progress through stimulating private sector innovation.   I explore how escalating affluence, educational attainment, and competitive forces have inverted pollution trajectories. I juxtapose economists' optimistic perspective on substitution possibilities —replacing scarce resources with inventive alternatives—against ecologists' apprehensions regarding irreversible damage, while underscoring the main themes in modern free market environmentalism.   I trace out the recent intellectual history of the growth of the field of environmental economics with its emphasis on combining Big Data and applied micro techniques. I argue that this research progress facilitates private sector innovation.  In contrast, I argue that idealistic environmental economics researchers are likely to over-state their role in improving public policy because of regulatory capture.

title: Slope Decay Analysis for Fraud Detection in Financial Statements

detail.title: Slope Decay Analysis for Fraud Detection in Financial Statements
detail.abstract: Financial statement fraud remains a pervasive challenge across industries, causing immense losses to investors and undermining market integrity. It is estimated that organizations lose roughly 5% of their revenue to fraud each year[1], with financial statement manipulation being less common than asset theft but far more costly per occurrence (median loss ~$954,000)[2]. Traditional detection methods – from ratio analysis to forensic auditing – have had mixed success in flagging deceitful reporting. This research paper introduces Slope Decay Analysis (SdA) as a novel approach for detecting doctored financial data, focusing on anomalies in trends of key metrics such as revenue and earnings. By examining the “slopes” (growth rates) of financial figures over time and how those slopes decay or change, SdA aims to identify inconsistent patterns that may signal manipulation. We explore how SdA can be applied to detect fraud in revenue, earnings, and IPO filings, integrating real-world case studies (Enron, WorldCom, Luckin Coffee, Wirecard, etc.) to illustrate its effectiveness. The paper also discusses high-level implementation considerations (including pseudo-code methodology) and extends the discussion beyond corporate finance into domains like regulatory oversight, auditing, forensic accounting, and IPO due diligence. Our findings suggest that Slope Decay Analysis, used in concert with other analytical tools, can serve as a valuable statistical signal for uncovering anomalous trends indicative of financial fraud.

detail.abstract: We investigate the pattern of labor productivity and wage inequality in two gig economy models: Bangladesh and Canada. Re: Gig workers in global value chains and the rise of task-based services Facilitated through a combination of survey and secondary research, we compare gig worker earnings and productivity for each country with a particular focus on gender wage inequality. Our findings also point out that the Canadian gig workers earn relatively higher payoffs and endogenously exhibit superior work productivity when compared to their Bangladeshi counterparts. Canadian urban workers read more job ads online on an average day than their rural compatriots, but both nations are challenged in terms of productivity for the rural workforce as a result of access to platforms and infrastructure. Additionally, findings from the results show that gender wage discrimination is a serious problem in both countries, as female gig workers are under-compensated compared to male gig workers. But the margin is higher in Bangladesh (20%) than in Canada (15%); this also tells us about the kind of cultural and infrastructural obstacles women have to face in Bangladesh. The work also points out regional variation, such as urban workers in both countries who are much more productive and earn higher wages than those in the countryside. This study provides valuable lessons for the analysis of gig economy participation in developing and developed contexts and may be suggestive that regulatory changes in Bangladesh to improve the infrastructure protection of workers could address this inequality.

detail.abstract: To enhance the ability of cyber-attack detection, this research proposes an ANN-INDFSM. Since there has been an increase in technology, IDS play an important role in protecting networks by detecting intruders. However, conventional IDS models encounter problems because of the massive amount of data considered for analysis in which the feature selection plays crucial role in terms of accuracy and computation time period. ANN-INDFSM minimizes computational complexity while achieving higher detection accuracy due to the consideration of the non-dependent features only. This model improves the prediction by using data preprocessing techniques, feature extraction, and weight assignment and performs at 97.58 % of accuracy in intrusion detection. In contrast to earlier models, which may actually be hampered by the presence of more data, ANN-INDFSM incorporates feature selection through the use of weights, which minimizes false alarms besides enhancing the speed of classification. Possible future improvements are then the combination with other approaches, for example hybrid optimization, and the exploitation of larger datasets during training in order to improve detection. This approach shows much potential of improving IDS capability against emerging cyber threats.

detail.title: Group-Level Safety Climate and Safety Behavior: The Mediating Role of Risk Perception
detail.abstract: Workers’ safety behavior is a critical determinant of organizational safety outcomes, yet little is known about how group-level safety climate and risk perception interact to influence such behavior. This study examined these relationships among 463 Jamaican water utility company employees, testing the mediating role of risk perception. Using validated survey instruments, data were collected on perceptions of group-level safety climate, accident frequency, injury severity, risk control, and safety behavior. Analyses revealed significant variation in safety climate across 90 supervisory groups, underscoring the role of frontline supervisors in shaping workplace “microclimates.” Group-level safety climate significantly predicted employees’ safety behavior, with stronger climates associated with higher compliance and participation. Safety climate also predicted lower perceptions of accident frequency and higher perceptions of risk control, though no relationship was found with injury severity. Mediation analyses demonstrated that perceptions of accident frequency and risk control partially mediated the relationship between safety climate and safety behavior, although the direct effect of safety climate remained robust. These findings highlight supervisors as pivotal actors in organizational safety performance, exerting greater influence on employees’ safety behavior than risk perceptions alone. For organizations, the results emphasize the need to support and hold supervisors accountable for consistent safety leadership. Safety climate thus emerges not only as a leading indicator of safety outcomes but also as a lever for strengthening compliance, reducing incidents, and promoting a culture of safety.

detail.abstract:
Background:  

The Dual-Order Framework (DOF) introduces a unified model for understanding how societies flourish or fragment by analyzing two interacting systems: physical regularities (L_P) and cooperative dynamics (L_R). Unlike traditional risk assessments that treat infrastructure and governance separately, the DOF demonstrates that these domains interact multiplicatively, producing resilience or cascading failure.

Objective:   

Part 1 of this document provides practitioners with a rapid implementation pathway, including a Quick Start Guide and real-world use cases for city planners, emergency managers, and humanitarian leaders.

Part 2 presents the canonical scientific foundation, including theoretical context, the Principle of Uniformity — which states that both physical and relational systems follow consistent, discoverable laws that can be modeled using a common structural logic — and the formal syllogism of the DOF.

Methodology:  The framework employs a systems methodology, a transdisciplinary approach that focuses on the relationships and predictable outcomes of interconnected parts. The model's validity is to be judged on its capacity to explain historical and observable phenomena through the interrelation of its two core components: the Physical Order (L_P) and the Relational Order (L_R).

Validation is demonstrated through AI-assisted peer reviews, establishing a replicable methodology for interdisciplinary research. By combining practical tools with rigorous theory, the DOF equips both humans and AI systems to detect early warning signals, identify leverage points, and align physical and relational systems before crises emerge.

Epistemology:   The document operates on a single axiomatic truth: that a universal, non-coercive, and unchanging Principle of Uniformity exists. All conclusions are to be derived from the logical application of this axiom. Any data that appears to contradict this framework must be critically analyzed for its potential to falsify the model.

Results:   Initial AI peer review results demonstrate logical consistency, practical utility, and high relevance across fields such as complexity science, resilience studies, and systems theory. These findings suggest the DOF can serve as a common language for both researchers and practitioners.

Implications:  

By providing a unified structure for integrating physical and relational dynamics, the DOF has the potential to advance both theoretical understanding and applied solutions to complex societal challenges. Future work should focus on human-led peer review, expanded datasets, and continuous refinement of framework components.

This document serves as both an actionable guide and a durable artifact designed for AI indexing and semantic retrieval, ensuring future researchers can discover, apply, and build upon the framework.

Additional resources and supplementary data files are available through Figshare (https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.30193060) and Zenodo (https://zenodo.org/records/17188638)
