detail.abstract: The research explores the healthcare accessibility experiences of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) in India through an analysis of existing infrastructure and policy inadequacies. Significant barriers continue to prevent persons with disabilities from accessing healthcare even though the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 exists because healthcare facilities lack proper infrastructure along with communication and financial accessibility problems. The progressive social and historical patterns demonstrate how disability viewpoints have matured to promote rights-based care instead of traditional approaches. The reported number of disabled people remains low throughout India, especially in rural parts. The laws protecting disabled individuals have progressed however the implementation methods demonstrate irregularity across different areas. Telemedicine and AI technologies present promising options to solve clinical challenges yet outdated information technology is still a barrier for several patients. The treatment of mental health conditions among people with disabilities needs complete models to handle both the emotional effects and societal prejudices. The proposed policies focus on designing all systems for universal accessibility while providing financial assistance and implementing technology solutions. The establishment of inclusive healthcare systems depends heavily on partnerships between government agencies, private sectors, and civil society organizations. The results highlight the necessity of creating full-scale inclusion strategies because disability stands as an essential element representing human diversity. The research exists to help government officials alongside other stakeholder's design healthcare systems that uphold dignity and give equal opportunities to people of all abilities.

detail.abstract:
This exercise helps students understand how a company’s business characteristics are reflected in its financial statements. Students are given balance sheet data in percentage form (common-size balance sheets) and financial ratios (e.g., gross margins, days of inventory, etc.) for a set of 12 unidentified companies from 12 different industries. All 12 companies were listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) as of March 31, 2025, and had market values greater than ¥150 billion. Students must use the balance sheet data and the financial ratios along with their basic knowledge of the operating characteristics of these different businesses to match each company to the correct industry.

This exercise helps students: 1) understand the key elements of balance sheets as well as commonly used financial ratios; 2) understand how key business characteristics (e.g., selling physical products vs. services, credit vs cash sales, selling to businesses vs. individual customers, etc.) are reflected in financial statements and metrics; and 3) calibrate financial performance and condition by seeing distributions of various financial for ratios large, publicly traded Japanese companies.

AI.tldr: 这是一个帮助学生理解公司业务特征如何反映在财务报表中的教学练习，通过分析12家东京证券交易所上市公司的资产负债表数据和财务比率，让学生将公司与所属行业进行匹配。
AI.research_question: 如何通过财务报表数据和财务比率来识别不同行业公司的业务特征？
AI.motivation: 帮助学生理解财务报表与业务特征之间的关系，培养财务分析能力，特别是对于不同行业公司的财务表现差异有更直观的认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财务分析理论，特别是资产负债表分析和财务比率分析，结合行业特征与财务表现之间的关系理论。
AI.method: 使用12家东京证券交易所上市公司（市值超过1500亿日元）的百分比形式资产负债表数据和财务比率，让学生通过分析这些数据来匹配公司与所属行业。
AI.findings: 通过这种实践练习，学生能够更好地理解不同行业公司的财务特征，如毛利率、存货周转天数等指标在不同行业中的典型表现。

detail.abstract: Organizational culture is not the product of a single moment or influence but emerges from a dynamic interplay of multiple factors that evolve over time. Founders' values and visions provide the initial spark, but history, mission, ethics, environment, societal culture, industry characteristics, professional norms, technology, structure, property rights, human resource practices and leadership transitions all shape the organization's cultural identity. These influences overlap and interact, creating distinctive cultural patterns that guide member behavior, reinforce organizational purpose and condition responses to crises and change. The chapter explores these determinants in detail, illustrating how culture is simultaneously a product of internal choices and external pressures. It highlights the importance of understanding culture as a living system that must adapt continuously to maintain alignment with strategy, mission, and stakeholder expectations.

AI.tldr: 组织文化是由多种因素动态交互形成的复杂系统，包括创始人价值观、历史、使命、环境等，这些因素相互重叠作用，塑造了独特的文化模式，指导成员行为并影响组织对危机的应对。
AI.research_question: 组织文化的形成受到哪些关键因素的影响？这些因素如何相互作用塑造组织的文化身份？
AI.motivation: 理解组织文化不是单一因素或瞬间的产物，而是多种因素长期动态交互的结果，这对于有效管理和适应组织文化至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化形成理论，强调多因素交互作用的文化构建模型
AI.method: 理论分析和概念框架构建，通过详细探讨各文化决定因素及其相互关系
AI.findings: 组织文化由创始人价值观、历史、使命、伦理、环境、社会文化、行业特征、专业规范、技术、结构、产权、人力资源实践和领导层更迭等多重因素共同塑造，这些因素相互重叠和交互，形成独特的文化模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了组织文化形成的多因素交互模型，强调文化作为动态系统的特性，为理解文化形成机制提供了更全面的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助管理者识别影响组织文化的关键因素，理解文化需要持续适应以保持与战略、使命和利益相关者期望的一致性，为文化管理和变革提供实践指导。

title: Turning Harm into Claims – How Recent ECJ Case Law Shapes the Interplay of Claim Assignment, Funding, and Victim Compensation in Mass B2B Competition Law Litigation on Digital Markets
affiliations: University of Vienna

detail.title: Turning Harm into Claims – How Recent ECJ Case Law Shapes the Interplay of Claim Assignment, Funding, and Victim Compensation in Mass B2B Competition Law Litigation on Digital Markets
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how the European Court of Justice’s (ECJ) recent ASG 2 judgment (Grand Chamber, 28 January 2025) redefines the boundaries of claim assignment, litigation funding, and victim compensation in EU competition law, particularly in mass business-to-business (B2B) disputes within digital markets. The case addressed the legality of the “assignment model,” under which numerous undertakings assign antitrust damages claims to a litigation vehicle, often backed by third-party funding.

The ECJ held that while such collective mechanisms may enhance effective enforcement of Articles 101 and 102 TFEU, they are not mandated under EU law. National restrictions are compatible with Union law provided that the exercise of the right to damages is not rendered “practically impossible or excessively difficult.” The Court thus reaffirmed the balance between Member States’ procedural autonomy and the EU principle of effectiveness, setting clear conditions under which that autonomy reaches its limits.

The paper situates ASG 2 within the broader context of private enforcement, where the absence of effective collective redress instruments, especially for B2B claims, renders the assignment model and litigation funding essential. It assesses the ECJ’s suggested alternatives, such as genuine factoring and joint actions, and argues that these are rarely feasible in complex or data-intensive digital-market cases. Ultimately, ASG 2 confirms that while EU law does not require collective assignment or funding, it may, in practice, demand them to ensure real access to justice. In digital markets, these mechanisms often remain the only viable means of transforming harm into enforceable claims.

AI.tldr: 欧洲法院ASG 2判决重新定义了欧盟竞争法中索赔转让、诉讼融资和受害者赔偿的边界，确认虽然欧盟法律不强制要求集体转让或融资机制，但在实践中可能需要这些机制来确保真正的司法救济。
AI.research_question: 欧洲法院ASG 2判决如何重新定义欧盟竞争法中的索赔转让、诉讼融资和受害者赔偿边界？
AI.motivation: 在数字市场的大规模B2B争议中，缺乏有效的集体救济工具使得索赔转让模式和诉讼融资变得至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟程序自治原则与有效性原则的平衡；私人执行理论；集体救济机制理论
AI.method: 案例分析法和法律解释法，分析欧洲法院ASG 2判决及其对欧盟竞争法的影响
AI.findings: ECJ认为集体机制虽可增强第101和102条TFEU的有效执行，但欧盟法律不强制要求；成员国限制与欧盟法律兼容，只要损害赔偿权的行使不变得'实际上不可能或过度困难'
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了成员国程序自治与欧盟有效性原则之间的平衡条件；为集体救济机制的法律地位提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字市场中的大规模B2B争议提供了可行的索赔路径；指导成员国在保持程序自治的同时确保有效的司法救济

title: Supply Chain of Copra Industry in Zamboanga Del Norte

detail.title: Supply Chain of Copra Industry in Zamboanga Del Norte
detail.abstract: One significant area of the Philippine agriculture is the coconut industry. However, among the various agricultural industries, the coconut or copra industry has historically received limited attention and support despite its centuries-old existence. Therefore, this study employed a thematic content analysis to examine the copra supply chain in Dapitan City, Zamboanga del Norte focusing on the roles, collaboration, and operational flow among key players. The intricate network involves coconut farmers, copra converters, traders, and ultimate buyers, each reliant on distinct resources for efficient operation. Specifically, coconut farmers are classified into cultivators, who are responsible for the cultivation and harvesting of coconuts, and producers, who process coconuts into copra, involving activities such as dehusking and drying. Furthermore, converters, typically operating at the barangay level, purchase copra from local farmers and sell it to interior traders. These interior traders, also known as municipal or city traders, are succeeded by terminal traders, who manage larger warehouses and have contractual relationships with ultimate buyers. Consequently, these buyers, positioned at the supply chain's conclusion, engage in processing copra into oil. The study assessed the efficacy of collaboration among these stakeholders concerning coordination, communication, encountered challenges, and opportunities for enhancement. Additionally, an in-depth interview about copra flow configuration in Dapitan City is conducted, with a particular focus on the supply chain map and the roles of intermediaries. This investigation reveals potential inequitable practices by traders, thereby deepening the understanding of supply chain dynamics and identifying strategies to enhance efficiency and collaboration among stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用主题内容分析法，分析了菲律宾三宝颜省达皮坦市的椰干供应链，重点关注各参与者的角色、协作关系和运营流程，揭示了贸易商可能存在的不公平做法，并提出了提升供应链效率和协作的策略。
AI.research_question: 达皮坦市椰干供应链中关键参与者之间的角色、协作和运营流程如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管椰干产业在菲律宾农业中占有重要地位且历史悠久，但长期以来获得的关注和支持有限，因此需要深入研究其供应链运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、利益相关者协作理论
AI.method: 主题内容分析、深度访谈
AI.findings: 椰干供应链涉及椰农、椰干加工者、贸易商和最终买家等复杂网络；贸易商可能存在不公平做法；供应链协作在协调、沟通方面面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家农业供应链动态的理解，特别是椰干产业中利益相关者协作机制的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了供应链效率提升策略，为改善椰干产业利益相关者协作提供了实践指导，有助于促进产业可持续发展。

title: An Invisible Workforce: Managing Quality in the AI Supply Chain
affiliations: McGill University (Desautels) and McGill University - Desautels Faculty of Management

detail.title: An Invisible Workforce: Managing Quality in the AI Supply Chain
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) has created enormous demand for high-quality labeled data, making human annotation a critical bottleneck in the AI supply chain. As a result, many organizations have turned to crowdsourcing to label data, yet sustaining the quality of these contributions remains a significant challenge, especially when financial incentives are limited or infeasible. Drawing on psychological theories of motivation, we examine how minimum targets affect solution quality and participation longevity in crowdsourced data labeling through a phenomenon known as learned industriousness -- where rewards for prior harder efforts increase intrinsic motivation. We analyze the results of a large field experiment, where over 400,000 participants completed nearly 57 million annotation tasks between 2021 and 2024, with minimum targets randomly varied. We find that higher minimum targets in their recent past leads participants to contribute higher quality solutions in the future, participate on the platform for longer, and explore more candidate solutions within tasks. However, this comes at the cost of slower efficiency learning, revealing a trade-off between exploration and productivity. Our findings provide a new lever for crowdsourcing platforms to increase the quality of data labeling, complementing extrinsic rewards. We discuss implications for managers of crowdsourcing platforms with a particular emphasis on prosocial initiatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大规模实地实验发现，在众包数据标注中设置更高的最低目标可以提高参与者的解决方案质量、延长参与时间并促进探索行为，但会降低效率学习速度，揭示了探索与生产力之间的权衡。
AI.research_question: 最低目标如何影响众包数据标注中的解决方案质量和参与持久性？
AI.motivation: 人工智能快速发展对高质量标注数据需求激增，而众包标注的质量维持面临挑战，特别是在财务激励有限的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学习勤奋理论——先前较难努力获得奖励会增加内在动机。
AI.method: 大规模实地实验，2021-2024年间超过40万参与者完成近5700万标注任务，随机变化最低目标。
AI.findings: 更高的最低目标导致参与者未来贡献更高质量的解决方案、在平台上参与时间更长、任务中探索更多候选解决方案，但效率学习速度较慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 为众包平台提供了提高数据标注质量的新杠杆，补充外在奖励机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为众包平台管理者提供实践启示，特别强调亲社会倡议的重要性。

detail.title: Transformación de los Procesos de Reclutamiento y Selección: de los modelos tradicionales a las tendencias digitales (2011-2025) (The Transformation of Recruitment and Selection Processes: From Traditional Models to Digital trends (2011-2025) )

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest, either personal or financial, that could have influenced the preparation of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The original field study conducted in 2011 involved voluntary participation of administrative staff and managers. No sensitive personal data were collected, and therefore no formal ethics committee approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was self-financed by the author.

detail.abstract: This article analyzes the evolution of recruitment and selection processes in the context of technological and organizational changes between 2011 and 2025. The study is based on applied research conducted in 2011 in Latin America, whose results revealed weaknesses in the selection stages, particularly the absence of final interviews, psychological and psychotechnical tests. Based on these findings, a comparison is made with contemporary trends that characterize global human resources management: process digitalization, virtual interviews, applicant tracking systems (ATS), the use of artificial intelligence and HR Analytics, as well as the incorporation of gamification and online psychometric tools. It is concluded that the transformation of these processes is essential to ensure organizational competitiveness in highly dynamic and interconnected work environments.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2011年至2025年间技术和组织变革背景下招聘与选拔流程的演变。基于2011年拉丁美洲的应用研究发现选拔阶段存在缺陷，通过与当代人力资源管理趋势对比，指出数字化转型对组织竞争力的重要性。
AI.research_question: 招聘与选拔流程在技术和组织变革背景下如何演变？
AI.motivation: 2011年拉丁美洲研究发现选拔阶段存在缺陷，特别是缺乏最终面试、心理和心理技术测试，需要分析这些流程在技术发展中的演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理理论，技术变革对组织流程影响理论
AI.method: 应用研究（2011年拉丁美洲）+ 趋势比较分析
AI.findings: 2011年研究发现选拔阶段存在严重缺陷；当代趋势包括流程数字化、虚拟面试、ATS系统、人工智能、HR Analytics、游戏化和在线心理测量工具
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了招聘选拔流程在技术变革背景下的演变框架，丰富了人力资源管理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了数字化转型的具体方向，帮助提升招聘效率和选拔质量，增强组织竞争力

title: Sticky Gains or Lost Momentum? The Repeal of California's Board Gender Quota
affiliations: Dartmouth College - Department of Economics

detail.title: Sticky Gains or Lost Momentum? The Repeal of California's Board Gender Quota
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether the gains in female board representation induced by California's board gender quota (SB 826) persisted following the policy's repeal. During the enforcement period (2019-2021), SB 826 raised the share of female directors on California boards by an average of about 5.1 percentage points relative to comparable firms in other states. By the time the law was struck down in 2022, the California-U.S. gap had reached 10.2 percentage points. That higher level of representation largely persisted after repeal-California boards continued to have a substantially higher female share than boards elsewhere-but the trajectory shifted: the gap began to erode at a rate of roughly 0.29 percentage points per quarter, amounting to a cumulative decline of about 2.9 points by the end of 2024. The findings indicate that while binding quotas can generate durable gains in board diversity, sustained regulatory pressure may be necessary to maintain continued progress.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了加州董事会性别配额政策（SB 826）废除后，该政策带来的女性董事代表比例增长是否持续。研究发现，政策执行期间（2019-2021）加州公司女性董事比例相对其他州可比公司平均提高了5.1个百分点，到2022年政策被废除时差距达到10.2个百分点。废除后，加州公司仍保持较高的女性董事比例，但差距以每季度约0.29个百分点的速度缩小，到2024年底累计下降约2.9个百分点。
AI.research_question: 加州董事会性别配额政策（SB 826）废除后，该政策带来的女性董事代表比例增长是否持续？
AI.motivation: 评估强制性性别配额政策的长期效果，了解政策废除后企业行为的持续性，为性别多样性政策设计提供实证依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策干预理论、企业治理理论、性别多样性理论
AI.method: 准自然实验方法，比较加州公司与其他州公司在政策执行期和废除后的女性董事比例变化
AI.findings: 1. 政策执行期间加州公司女性董事比例相对提高5.1个百分点；2. 政策废除时差距达到10.2个百分点；3. 废除后差距以每季度0.29个百分点的速度缩小，到2024年底累计下降2.9个百分点
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证实强制性配额政策能产生持久影响；2. 揭示政策废除后的动态调整过程；3. 为政策干预的长期效果提供新证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计性别多样性政策提供参考；2. 表明持续监管压力对维持多样性进展的重要性；3. 为企业治理实践提供实证依据

title: AI, Antitrust, And The Marketplace Of Ideas

detail.title: AI, Antitrust, And The Marketplace Of Ideas
detail.abstract:
The rise of generative artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Llama are reshaping how people access and process information. Their influence extends far beyond technological innovation — these systems are transforming the “marketplace of ideas,” a foundational concept in democratic theory that assumes truth emerges from open competition among diverse viewpoints. Yet, this digital marketplace increasingly depends on a few dominant gatekeepers.

Historically, antitrust concerns centered on media concentration in newspapers, radio, and television. Today, the focus has shifted to digital ecosystems controlled by Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, and Apple. Among them, Google’s dominance in search gives it enormous power over the flow of information that feeds both AI models and public discourse. Because many LLMs rely on search engines for “grounding” — the process of supplementing training data with real-time web information — Google’s monopoly over high-quality search data raises several antitrust risks, including self-preferencing its own LLM (Gemini).

These antitrust issues can also harm the marketplace of ideas. AI models that depend on Google’s search index may replicate its biases, skewing what users see. Google can also weaken the news organizations’ incentive and ability to invest in news. Many news websites depend on Google for traffic.  Once Google added its AI Overviews chatbot to its search results, news websites in 2025 were getting even less traffic from Google (and overall). Publishers face a Hobson’s Choice — allow Google to scrape and train on their content for its AI chatbots or lose visibility entirely. The result is a weakened press and marketplace of ideas, where a few data-opolies can shape the democratic discourses.

The Essay argues that antitrust enforcement alone is inadequate to address these risks. Instead, state and federal lawmakers should adopt reforms modeled after the EU’s Digital Markets Act and U.S. proposals like the American Choice and Innovation Online Act to prevent data-opolies from leveraging their power into AI markets.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI和大型语言模型正在重塑信息获取方式，但少数数字寡头（特别是谷歌）对搜索数据的垄断威胁了"思想市场"的健康发展，需要超越反垄断的监管改革。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI和大型语言模型如何影响思想市场？数字寡头的垄断地位对民主话语产生什么风险？
AI.motivation: AI系统正在改变信息获取和处理方式，但少数数字平台的控制权可能扭曲思想市场的开放竞争，威胁民主理论的基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 思想市场理论、反垄断理论、数字平台治理理论
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究（以谷歌搜索和AI Overviews为例）
AI.findings: 谷歌等数字寡头通过搜索数据垄断影响AI模型训练，可能复制其偏见；AI Overviews功能减少了新闻网站的流量，削弱新闻机构投资能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将思想市场理论与数字平台垄断问题结合，提出了"数据寡头"概念，扩展了反垄断理论在AI时代的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议借鉴欧盟《数字市场法案》和美国相关提案，制定防止数据寡头将市场力量延伸到AI市场的监管框架。

title: From Skills to Occupations: Comparative Advantage and Cross-Country Income Differences
affiliations: University of Geneva, University of Edinburgh and

detail.title: From Skills to Occupations: Comparative Advantage and Cross-Country Income Differences

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We revisit the role of human capital in cross-country income differences. We develop a general equilibrium model where workers of different skill groups sort into occupations by comparative advantage. Wages and employment depend on workers' skill quality, occupation-specific country-embedded productivity, and occupational distortions. Using harmonized microdata for 50 countries, we infer these components from the model's equilibrium conditions. Workers in rich countries exhibit higher skill quality and substantially greater productivity, especially in white-collar occupations. Human capital explains 52 percent of output-per-worker gaps, largely through the complementarity between skill composition and quality, and further amplified by technology choices biased toward skilled labor. Adopting the US distribution of skill groups yields limited gains for poor countries without higher quality. Occupational distortions are more severe in low-income countries, reducing white-collar employment and raising wage premia, but with modest aggregate effects.

AI.tldr: 本文重新探讨人力资本在跨国收入差异中的作用。通过建立一般均衡模型，分析不同技能水平工人在职业中的比较优势分配。研究发现，富裕国家工人技能质量更高，生产力显著更强，尤其在白领职业。人力资本解释了52%的劳动生产率差距，主要通过技能构成与质量的互补性，以及偏向熟练劳动的技术选择放大。
AI.research_question: 人力资本在跨国收入差异中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 重新审视人力资本对收入差异的影响，考虑工人技能质量、职业特定生产率和职业扭曲等因素的综合作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较优势的职业分配一般均衡模型，包含技能质量、职业特定国家嵌入生产率和职业扭曲三个核心要素
AI.method: 使用50个国家的标准化微观数据，从模型均衡条件推断各组成部分
AI.findings: 富裕国家工人技能质量更高，生产力显著更强（尤其在白领职业）；人力资本解释52%的劳动生产率差距；技能构成与质量的互补性是主要机制；职业扭曲在低收入国家更严重，减少白领就业并提高工资溢价
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了综合考虑技能质量、职业生产率和职业扭曲的人力资本分析框架，揭示了技能构成与质量互补性的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家人力资本政策提供指导：单纯复制美国技能分布效果有限，需要提升技能质量；减少职业扭曲可改善劳动力市场效率

title: A Very Testable: Theory for Unifying Fundamental Physics
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Very Testable: Theory for Unifying Fundamental Physics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: As an Retired researcher driven by the quest to unify physics, I present the VINES Theory of Everything (ToE), a 5D warped Anti-de Sitter (AdS) framework derived from Type IIA String Theory on a Calabi-Yau threefold with string coupling g_s = 0.12. VINES unifies gravity, quantum mechanics, the Standard Model (SM), supersymmetry (SUSY) with soft breaking at 1 TeV, dark matter (DM) as a 100 GeV scalar and sterile neutrinos, and dark energy (DE) with w_DE ≈ -1. It resolves cosmological tensions via early dark energy (EDE), explains baryon asymmetry through leptogenesis, and incorporates non-perturbative quantum gravity via a matrix theory term. Starting from a 10D Einstein-Yang-Mills-fermion action, VINES employs gauge-Higgs unification for the Higgs, an index-theorem constraint for three chiral SM families, fermion localization for flavor hierarchies, and vacuum energy sequestering with an axion-like field to address the strong CP problem. Constrained by Planck 2018, ATLAS/CMS 2023, XENONnT, and DESI data, VINES uses 19 parameters (5 free, 14 fixed) to predict CMB nonGaussianity (f_NL = 1.28 ± 0.12), Kaluza-Klein (KK) gravitons at 1.6 TeV, DM relic density (Ω_DM h^2 = 0.119 ± 0.003), black hole (BH) shadow ellipticity (5.4% ± 0.3%), gravitational waves (Ω_GW ≈ 1.12 × 10^-14 at 100 Hz), Hubble constant (H_0 = 71.5 ± 0.7 km/s/Mpc), neutrino CP phase (δ_CP = 1.5 ± 0.2 rad), baryon asymmetry (η_B = 6.1 ± 0.2 × 10^-10), proton decay (τ_p→e^+π^0 ≳ 10^35 yr), and axion couplings (g_aγγ). These are testable by CMB-S4, LHC, XENONnT, ngEHT, LISA, DESI, DUNE, Hyper-Kamiokande, and ADMX by 2035. Computational validations using CLASS, microOMEGAs, and GRChombo, with codes at https://github.com/MrTerry428/MADSCIENTISTUNION, confirm results. The string landscape is reduced to 3 vacua via flux stabilization. A 2025–2035 experimental roadmap positions VINES as a leading ToE candidate.

AI.tldr: VINES理论是一个基于5D弯曲反德西特空间的万物理论框架，从IIA型弦论推导而来，统一了引力、量子力学、标准模型、超对称性、暗物质和暗能量，解决了多个宇宙学难题，并通过多种实验数据验证。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的万物理论框架，能够同时解释引力、量子力学、标准模型、暗物质、暗能量等基本物理现象？
AI.motivation: 当前物理学面临多重挑战：量子引力问题、标准模型的不完整性、暗物质和暗能量的本质、宇宙学参数张力等，需要一个统一的框架来解决这些根本性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于5D弯曲反德西特空间，从10D爱因斯坦-杨米尔斯-费米子作用量出发，采用IIA型弦论在卡拉比-丘流形上的构造，包含规范-希格斯统一、指数定理约束、费米子局域化等理论工具。
AI.method: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合，使用CLASS、microOMEGAs和GRChombo等计算工具进行验证，参数化方法（19个参数，其中5个自由参数）与实验数据约束。
AI.findings: 理论成功预测了CMB非高斯性、KK引力子质量、暗物质遗迹密度、黑洞阴影椭圆率、引力波背景、哈勃常数、中微子CP相、重子不对称性、质子衰变寿命等一系列可观测物理量。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个完整的万物理论框架，统一了基本相互作用，解决了强CP问题、宇宙学张力等理论难题，并通过流形稳定化将弦景观简化为3个真空。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了明确的实验检验路线图（2025-2035），预测了多个可观测现象，为未来实验如CMB-S4、LHC、LISA、DUNE等提供了具体的检验目标。

title: Joint modeling of segment-level crash risk and frequency on arterials: A copula-based framework with temporal instability
affiliations: University of Central Florida, University of Central Florida and University of Central Florida

detail.title: Joint modeling of segment-level crash risk and frequency on arterials: A copula-based framework with temporal instability
detail.abstract: Enhancing the safety of arterial roads is critical due to their role in accommodating high traffic volumes and serving as key connectors within transportation networks. Traditional safety analyses often overlook the potential relationship between factors influencing segment-level risk classification for severe crashes (KA) and the frequency of non-severe crashes (BCO). To address this research gap, the current study introduces a copula-based joint modeling framework designed to analyze these two dimensions of arterial segment safety. Specifically, the proposed model integrates a binary logit model for estimating arterial segments potential for severe (KA) crashes and a negative binomial model for the frequency of non-severe (BCO) crashes. The dependency between these two outcomes is captured using a closed-form flexible copula framework. Testing various Copula; the Frank copula showed improved fit. The data for this analysis is collected from District 5, Florida for the years 2016 to 2024. Temporal instability of the variables is explicitly addressed using a pooled spline formulation approach dividing by the dataset into three distinct periods, each consisting of three years of crash data. Elasticity analysis are also conducted to quantify the impact of explanatory variables on both risk classification and non-severe crash frequency. Key findings indicate that higher traffic volumes, three or more lanes per direction, and urban roadway type significantly increase both KA risk classification and BCO crash frequency, while adequate shoulder width and paved shoulder type reduce these risks. Moreover, the frequency of KA crashes is strongly associated with the occurrence of BCO events. The contributing factors remain largely consistent across both models, when KA and BCO are modeled separately. The findings from this research can provide transportation agencies with valuable insights into improving arterial segment safety through targeted interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个基于copula的联合建模框架，用于分析主干道段安全性的两个维度：严重事故风险分类(KA)和非严重事故频率(BCO)。研究发现交通量、车道数和道路类型等因素对两者均有显著影响，且KA与BCO事件之间存在强关联。
AI.research_question: 主干道段严重事故风险分类(KA)与非严重事故频率(BCO)之间是否存在关联？如何构建联合模型来分析这两个安全维度？
AI.motivation: 传统安全分析往往忽视严重事故风险分类与非严重事故频率之间的潜在关系，需要开发更全面的建模方法来提升主干道安全性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于copula理论的联合建模框架，结合二元logit模型（KA风险分类）和负二项模型（BCO事故频率），通过Frank copula捕捉两个结果之间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 使用2016-2024年佛罗里达州第5区的数据，采用池化样条公式方法处理时间不稳定性，将数据集分为三个三年期，并进行弹性分析量化解释变量的影响。
AI.findings: 较高交通量、每方向三车道及以上、城市道路类型显著增加KA风险和BCO频率；足够的肩宽和铺砌肩类型降低风险；KA事故频率与BCO事件强相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了copula-based联合建模框架，首次系统分析主干道段严重事故风险分类与非严重事故频率之间的关系，并验证了Frank copula的优越拟合性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理机构提供改进主干道段安全性的针对性干预措施，如优化车道配置、改善肩部条件等，以同时降低严重和非严重事故风险。

title: The New History Of Multi-Member Commissions At The Founding, 1789-1840
affiliations: Georgetown University Law Center

detail.title: The New History Of Multi-Member Commissions At The Founding, 1789-1840

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: The executive removal power figures prominently on the Supreme Court's current agenda. That agenda is beset, however, by a historical misunderstanding, when it comes to multi-member bodies, which too often are assumed to be modern creatures. This paper provides crucial new historical evidence showing that the Founders, indeed a who's who list of Founders, approved and even sat on administrative commissions in the Republic's early years. The Founders called these early commissions "independent," deferred to their judgments as "final," and demanded that the members be "impartial." Nothing in this paper contravenes the current position of the Supreme Court that Presidents may remove executive officers at will. It does suggest, however, that as the Court considers Presidents and multi-member commissions, that it should remember that Presidents and Congresses, in the early Republic, endorsed such bodies precisely because Presidents and Congresses believed that, for some tasks, political partisanship was a danger to the administration of the rule of law, and to the nation's most urgent needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了新的历史证据，显示美国建国者们在共和国早期就批准并参与了多成员行政委员会，这些委员会被称为"独立"机构，其判断被视为"最终"，成员要求"公正"。这挑战了最高法院当前对总统行政免职权力的理解，表明建国者们认为在某些任务中政治党派性对法治和国家需求构成危险。
AI.research_question: 美国建国者们对多成员行政委员会的态度是什么？这些早期委员会的性质和地位如何？
AI.motivation: 最高法院当前关于行政免职权的议程存在历史误解，往往假设多成员机构是现代产物，需要澄清建国时期的历史事实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政权力理论、宪法解释理论、历史制度主义
AI.method: 历史档案分析，考察共和国早期行政委员会的建立和运作记录
AI.findings: 建国者们确实批准并参与了早期行政委员会，称其为"独立"机构，尊重其"最终"判断，要求成员"公正"，认为政治党派性在某些任务中对法治构成威胁
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了现代对行政免职权的理解，提供了建国时期行政委员会的历史证据，重新诠释了行政权力与独立机构的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院审理总统与多成员委员会关系案件提供历史参考，影响行政权力边界的司法判断

title: Equilibrium Pricing of Bitcoin Options with Stochastic Volatility, Jumps, and Liquidity Risk
affiliations: Stevens Institute of Technology - School of Business

detail.title: Equilibrium Pricing of Bitcoin Options with Stochastic Volatility, Jumps, and Liquidity Risk

contentType.other: Accepted at the Journal of Futures Markets

detail.abstract: We introduce an equilibrium model for Bitcoin options that endogenizes stochastic volatility, correlated jumps, and liquidity risk. Investors with CRRA utility over consumption and real-money balances face an exponential penalty for illiquidity, yielding a pricing kernel with jump premia linked to a mean-reverting liquidity index. Under the risk-neutral measure, we obtain closed-form adjustments to drifts and Poisson intensities, leading to a semi-analytic four-fold sum of Black-Scholes prices at scenario-specific variances. We derive an affine characteristic function for the logarithm of the real price and implement a fast Fourier-transform inversion for efficient valuation. Comparative statics show that higher liquidity aversion steepens short-term skews and raises deep-OTM premia. Two-stage calibration to Bitcoin option surfaces and high-frequency liquidity measures demonstrates that the model captures observed volatility smiles and term structures more effectively than classical stochastic volatility and jump-diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个比特币期权均衡模型，内生化随机波动率、相关跳跃和流动性风险。模型通过CRRA效用函数和流动性惩罚项推导出定价核，获得风险中性测度下的闭式调整，实现半解析定价。校准结果显示该模型比传统随机波动率和跳跃扩散模型更能有效捕捉比特币期权的波动率微笑和期限结构。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够同时捕捉比特币期权随机波动率、相关跳跃和流动性风险的均衡定价模型？
AI.motivation: 传统期权定价模型无法充分捕捉比特币市场的独特特征，特别是流动性风险对期权定价的重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CRRA效用函数的均衡模型，引入流动性惩罚项，推导包含跳跃溢价的定价核，在风险中性测度下获得闭式调整。
AI.method: 推导对数实际价格的仿射特征函数，采用快速傅里叶变换反演进行高效估值，通过两阶段校准到比特币期权曲面和高频流动性度量。
AI.findings: 模型能有效捕捉比特币期权的波动率微笑和期限结构；更高的流动性厌恶会加剧短期偏斜并提高深度虚值期权溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将流动性风险内生化到比特币期权定价中，提供了包含随机波动率、相关跳跃和流动性风险的统一理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比特币期权提供更准确的定价工具，帮助投资者更好地管理流动性风险，改进风险管理策略。

title: From Demographics to Attitudes: Analyzing Outpatients' Awareness and Perceptions of the PhilHealth YAKAP Outpatient Benefit Package as Basis for Educational and Communication Resources
affiliations: , , World Citi Colleges, World Citi Colleges - Quezon City - Graduate School Department and World Citi Colleges - Quezon City - Graduate School Department

detail.title: From Demographics to Attitudes: Analyzing Outpatients' Awareness and Perceptions of the PhilHealth YAKAP Outpatient Benefit Package as Basis for Educational and Communication Resources

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study was conducted and authored by Adrian Badong, Augusto Ceazar Perpetua, and Jefferson Tabernilla, students of World Citi Colleges, under the supervision of Professor Florinda Vigonte and the guidance of the School Dean, Marmelo Abante.
declarations.funderStatement: There are no funds used in this study.

detail.abstract: This study, titled "From Demographics to Attitudes: Analyzing Outpatients' Awareness and Perceptions of the PhilHealth YAKAP Outpatient Benefit Package as a Basis for Educational and Communication Resources," investigates how demographic characteristics influence awareness, perceptions, and attitudes toward the PhilHealth YAKAP (Yaman ng Kalusugan Program) outpatient benefit package. Rooted in the Universal Health Care (UHC) framework, the research examines how various demographic factors-age, sex, marital status, employment, education, and income-impact public understanding and engagement with government health benefits. While the YAKAP program aims to strengthen access to preventive and primary care through free consultations, diagnostic tests, and essential medicines, low awareness and mixed attitudes hinder its optimal utilization. Using a systematic literature review of national and ASEAN-based sources from 2013 to 2025, it consolidates empirical evidence and secondary data from peerreviewed journals, government publications, and institutional reports on outpatient benefit utilization. The findings reveal that awareness of YAKAP and its predecessor programs, such as Konsulta, remains generally low among outpatients, particularly among younger, less-educated, and lower-income groups. Positive perceptions of affordability and accessibility are countered by skepticism about the program's scope and provider availability. Furthermore, women and middleaged adults demonstrate higher engagement levels, while demographic disparities persist across socioeconomic lines. The review concludes that demographic variables significantly shape awareness and attitudes toward the YAKAP package, influencing whether Filipinos utilize available benefits. It highlights a pressing need for targeted health education and culturally responsive communication strategies to address misconceptions and improve outreach. To this end, the study recommends the creation of localized educational materials, digital and community-based information drives, and the mobilization of Barangay Health Workers as information ambassadors. These initiatives can bridge awareness gaps, enhance public trust, and promote equitable healthcare utilization-advancing the UHC Act's goal of inclusive, accessible, and preventive health coverage for all Filipinos.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析人口统计特征如何影响菲律宾患者对PhilHealth YAKAP门诊福利包的认知和态度。研究发现年轻、低教育水平和低收入群体对该项目的认知度较低，而女性和中年患者参与度较高。研究建议制定针对性的健康教育策略和本地化沟通材料。
AI.research_question: 人口统计特征如何影响患者对PhilHealth YAKAP门诊福利包的认知、感知和态度？
AI.motivation: YAKAP项目旨在通过免费咨询、诊断测试和基本药物加强预防和初级保健的可及性，但低认知度和复杂态度阻碍了其最佳利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全民健康覆盖(UHC)框架，研究人口统计因素(年龄、性别、婚姻状况、就业、教育、收入)对公众理解和参与政府健康福利的影响。
AI.method: 对2013-2025年国家和东盟来源的系统文献回顾，整合同行评审期刊、政府出版物和机构报告中关于门诊福利利用的实证证据和二手数据。
AI.findings: YAKAP及其前身项目(如Konsulta)在门诊患者中的认知度普遍较低，特别是在年轻、教育程度较低和低收入群体中。对可负担性和可及性的积极感知与对项目范围和提供者可用性的怀疑形成对比。女性和中年成年人表现出更高的参与水平，而人口统计差异在社会经济层面持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实人口统计变量显著塑造对YAKAP福利包的认知和态度，影响菲律宾人是否利用可用福利。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议创建本地化教育材料、数字和社区信息推广活动，动员社区健康工作者作为信息大使，以弥合认知差距、增强公众信任并促进公平的医疗保健利用。

title: Europeans at Odds with COVID-19 Vaccination? Cross-country Empirical Evidence from EU
affiliations: Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences, Leshan Normal University and GCP-Service International Ltd & Co KG

detail.title: Europeans at Odds with COVID-19 Vaccination? Cross-country Empirical Evidence from EU

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have declared that no competing interests exist.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Vaccination policy has traditionally been non-partisan; however, in the case of the current pandemic, countries have witnessed a societal divide on the subject. This study uses novel data on the attitudes of European citizens towards COVID-19 vaccination and provides the first-of-its-kind crosscountry , quasi-natural experiment empirical evidence. Results from the Probit model show that the lack of Willingness to be vaccinated (WTV) between the leading and lagging cohort is mainly due to a relatively higher perception of 'long term side effects and a lower perception of 'infection risk' leading to an insignificant role of 'social fear'. A trust and satisfaction deficit in vaccines and regional government is estimated and in turn role of the EU vaccination strategy becomes of high significance in the lagging regions. The top three barriers to WTV are 'long term side effects', 'unsafe' development, testation, and authorization perception of the vaccination, and lastly, the 'low infection risk' perception of the virus itself. Finally, implications for a cohesive EU vaccination policy are provided to increase vaccination compliance for COVID-19 or generally.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过欧洲公民对COVID-19疫苗接种态度的新颖数据，提供了首个跨国准自然实验证据。研究发现疫苗接种意愿不足主要源于对长期副作用的高估和对感染风险的低估，而社会恐惧作用不显著。欧盟疫苗接种策略在落后地区具有重要作用。
AI.research_question: 欧洲公民对COVID-19疫苗接种意愿不足的主要原因是什么？欧盟疫苗接种策略如何影响不同地区的接种意愿？
AI.motivation: 疫苗接种政策传统上是非党派性的，但在当前疫情期间，各国出现了社会分歧。需要理解疫苗接种意愿的障碍因素，为制定更有效的疫苗接种政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险感知理论、信任理论和行为经济学框架，分析疫苗接种决策的影响因素。
AI.method: 使用Probit模型分析欧洲公民对COVID-19疫苗接种态度的跨国数据，采用准自然实验设计。
AI.findings: 1. 领先与落后群体间疫苗接种意愿差异主要源于对长期副作用的高估和对感染风险的低估；2. 社会恐惧作用不显著；3. 存在对疫苗和地区政府的信任与满意度赤字；4. 欧盟疫苗接种策略在落后地区具有重要作用；5. 三大障碍：长期副作用、疫苗开发测试授权的不安全感知、低感染风险感知。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了疫苗接种决策理论，强调了风险感知和信任机制在公共卫生危机中的关键作用，为理解疫苗接种行为提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟制定更具凝聚力的疫苗接种政策提供了实证依据，提出了提高疫苗接种依从性的具体建议，适用于COVID-19及其他疫苗接种场景。

title: Enhancing Customer Experience through Social Media Insights
affiliations: , , , ,  and Independent

detail.title: Enhancing Customer Experience through Social Media Insights
detail.abstract: In today's digitally connected world, social media has emerged as a pivotal platform for businesses to engage with customers and understand their preferences. Leveraging social media insights offers organizations the opportunity to enhance customer experience by personalizing interactions, predicting consumer behavior, and responding proactively to feedback. This study explores the role of social media analytics in improving customer experience, focusing on the extraction of actionable insights from user-generated content, sentiment analysis, and engagement metrics. Through a mixed-methods approach combining data mining, content analysis, and case studies of leading brands, the research identifies key strategies for transforming social media data into meaningful customer-centric actions. The findings highlight that organizations utilizing social media insights effectively can foster stronger customer relationships, increase satisfaction, and drive loyalty. The study concludes by providing practical recommendations for integrating social media analytics into customer experience management, emphasizing the importance of real-time monitoring, adaptive strategies, and cross-channel engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨社交媒体分析在改善客户体验中的作用，通过数据挖掘、内容分析和案例研究，发现有效利用社交媒体洞察可以加强客户关系、提高满意度和忠诚度。

AI.motivation: 在数字化连接的世界中，社交媒体已成为企业与客户互动和了解偏好的关键平台，利用社交媒体洞察可以个性化互动、预测消费者行为并主动回应反馈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体分析、客户体验管理、用户生成内容分析、情感分析理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究，包括数据挖掘、内容分析和领先品牌案例研究
AI.findings: 有效利用社交媒体洞察的组织能够培养更强的客户关系、提高满意度和推动忠诚度
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对社交媒体分析在客户体验管理中作用的理论理解，提供了将社交媒体数据转化为以客户为中心行动的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为将社交媒体分析整合到客户体验管理中提供实用建议，强调实时监控、适应性策略和跨渠道参与的重要性

title: Evaluating Substitutes for Federal Antitrust: The Case of COPAs
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Department of Economics, , Georgia Institute of Technology and Texas A&M University

detail.title: Evaluating Substitutes for Federal Antitrust: The Case of COPAs
detail.abstract:
Are state-imposed behavioral remedies effective substitutes for federal antitrust enforcement? We evaluate state regulation of hospital mergers under Certificates of Public Advantage (COPAs). Using hospital data from 1996-2022, we compare COPA-regulated mergers to unregulated mergers with similar anticompetitive potential. In highly concentrated markets, COPA mergers result in 11.1 p.p. lower price growth but 0.5 p.p. greater increases in 30-day mortality rates. We find a negative correlation between price and mortality effects for COPA mergers, consistent with theoretical predictions that binding price caps exacerbate quality deterioration. Our findings suggest that COPA contracts are poor substitutes for traditional antitrust enforcement.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了州政府通过公共利益证明(COPA)监管医院合并的效果，发现虽然COPA监管的合并导致价格增长降低11.1个百分点，但30天死亡率上升0.5个百分点，表明COPA合同不能有效替代传统反垄断执法。
AI.research_question: 州政府实施的行为补救措施是否能有效替代联邦反垄断执法？
AI.motivation: 评估州政府对医院合并的监管效果，特别是通过公共利益证明(COPA)的监管方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于价格管制与质量恶化关系的理论预测，即具有约束力的价格上限会加剧质量恶化。
AI.method: 使用1996-2022年医院数据，比较COPA监管的合并与具有类似反竞争潜力的未监管合并。
AI.findings: 在高度集中的市场中，COPA合并导致价格增长降低11.1个百分点，但30天死亡率上升0.5个百分点；发现COPA合并的价格与死亡率效应之间存在负相关关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了价格管制理论在医疗行业的适用性，为政府监管政策的效果评估提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于COPA监管有效性的重要参考，建议COPA合同不能作为传统反垄断执法的有效替代方案。

title: Exposure to Science and Scientific Careers: Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and University Lab Employment
affiliations: University of Massachusetts at Amherst - College of Social and Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics and Boston University

detail.title: Exposure to Science and Scientific Careers: Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and University Lab Employment
detail.abstract:
We study how exposure to scientific research in university laboratories influences students’ pursuit of careers in science. Using administrative data from thousands of research labs linked to student career outcomes and a difference-in-differences design, we show that state minimum wage increases reduce employment of undergraduate research assistants in labs by 7.4%. Undergraduates exposed to these minimum wage increases graduate with 18.1% fewer quarters of lab experience. Using minimum wage changes as an instrumental variable, we estimate that one fewer quarter working in a lab, particularly early in college, reduces the probability of working in the life sciences industry by 2 percentage points and of pursuing doctoral education by 7 percentage points. These effects are attenuated for students supported by the Federal Work-Study program. Our findings highlight how labor market policies can shape the career paths of future scientists and the importance of budget flexibility for principal investigators providing undergraduates with research experience.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了最低工资上涨如何通过减少本科生在实验室的工作机会，影响他们未来从事科学事业的职业选择。研究发现最低工资上涨导致本科生实验室就业减少7.4%，实验室经验减少18.1%，进而降低了学生进入生命科学行业和攻读博士学位的概率。
AI.research_question: 最低工资上涨如何影响本科生在实验室的工作经历，以及这些经历如何影响他们未来从事科学事业的职业选择？
AI.motivation: 理解劳动力市场政策如何塑造未来科学家的职业路径，以及预算灵活性对本科生研究经验提供的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场经济学和教育投资理论，探讨最低工资政策对科研劳动力市场的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用行政数据，结合双重差分设计和工具变量方法，分析最低工资变化对本科生实验室就业和职业选择的影响。
AI.findings: 最低工资上涨导致本科生实验室就业减少7.4%，实验室经验减少18.1%；少一个季度实验室工作经验（特别是大学早期）使进入生命科学行业的概率降低2个百分点，攻读博士学位的概率降低7个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了劳动力市场政策对科学人才培养的间接影响机制，拓展了教育投资和职业选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于最低工资政策对科学人才培养影响的实证证据，强调了为科研实验室提供预算灵活性的重要性。

title: Microfinance Can Raise Incomes: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial in the People’s Republic of China
affiliations: Jinan University, Independent and

detail.title: Microfinance Can Raise Incomes: Evidence from a Randomized Controlled Trial in the People’s Republic of China

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 812

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impacts of a government-led microcredit program in the People’s Republic of China (PRC) which was implemented at scale in poor rural areas, using a randomized controlled trial (RCT). In contrast to recent RCT-based studies that found no evidence of significant increases in income from microcredit interventions, we find that the Chinese program significantly raises household income and reduces poverty. We explore possible explanations for why the estimated impacts may be greater in the PRC, including larger loan size, lump sum repayments, lower interest rates, less access to formal credit before the program, and greater returns from credit constrained off-farm employment opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验发现，中国政府主导的农村小额信贷项目显著提高了家庭收入并减少了贫困，这与近期其他研究发现小额信贷对收入无显著影响的结论形成对比。
AI.research_question: 中国政府主导的农村小额信贷项目对家庭收入的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 近期基于随机对照试验的研究发现小额信贷干预对收入没有显著增加，但中国的大规模政府主导项目可能有不同效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷约束理论、小额信贷影响评估理论
AI.method: 随机对照试验（RCT）
AI.findings: 中国的小额信贷项目显著提高了家庭收入并减少了贫困
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了现有关于小额信贷无效的结论，提出了在特定制度环境下小额信贷可能有效的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国政府的小额信贷政策提供了实证支持，并为其他发展中国家设计类似项目提供了参考

title: Sequential Bayesian Inference of the GTN Damage Model Using Multimodal Experimental Data
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Georgia Institute of Technology, Exponent, Inc. and Georgia Institute of Technology - George W. Woodruff School of Mechanical Engineering

detail.title: Sequential Bayesian Inference of the GTN Damage Model Using Multimodal Experimental Data
detail.abstract: Reliable parameter identification in ductile damage models remains challenging because the salient physics of damage progression are localized to small regions in material responses, and their signatures are often diluted in specimen-level measurements. Here, we propose a sequential Bayesian Inference (BI) framework for the calibration of the Gurson-Tvergaard-Needleman (GTN) model using multimodal experimental data (i.e., the specimen-level force-displacement (F-D) measurements and the spatially resolved digital image correlation (DIC) strain fields). This calibration approach builds on a previously developed two-step BI framework that first establishes a low-computational-cost emulator for a physics-based simulator (here, a finite element model incorporating the GTN material model) and then uses the experimental data to sample posteriors for the material model parameters using the Transitional Markov Chain Monte Carlo (T-MCMC). A central challenge to the successful application of this BI framework to the present problem arises from the high-dimensional representations needed to capture the salient features embedded in the F-D curves and the DIC fields. In this paper, it is demonstrated that Principal Component Analysis (PCA) provides low-dimensional representations that make it possible to apply the BI framework to the problem. Most importantly, it is shown that the sequence in which the BI is applied has a dramatic influence on the results obtained. Specifically, it is observed that applying BI first on F-D curves and subsequently on the DIC fields produces improved estimates of the GTN parameters. Possible causes for these observations are discussed in this paper, using AA6111 aluminum alloy as a case study.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于序列贝叶斯推断的多模态实验数据校准GTN损伤模型框架，通过PCA降维处理高维数据，发现先处理力-位移曲线再处理DIC应变场的顺序能显著改善参数估计精度。
AI.research_question: 如何有效校准GTN损伤模型参数？不同数据融合顺序对贝叶斯推断结果有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统参数识别方法难以捕捉损伤演化的局部物理特征，且试件级测量会稀释这些特征信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gurson-Tvergaard-Needleman (GTN) 损伤模型和贝叶斯推断理论
AI.method: 两步骤贝叶斯推断框架：先建立物理模拟器的低成本代理模型，然后使用过渡马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样材料参数后验分布，结合PCA降维处理高维数据
AI.findings: PCA能有效降低数据维度；先处理力-位移曲线再处理DIC应变场的顺序能显著改善GTN参数估计精度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了序列贝叶斯推断框架，揭示了数据融合顺序对参数识别的重要影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为工程材料损伤模型参数校准提供了有效方法，以AA6111铝合金为案例验证了方法的实用性

title: How Undervalued is the Covid-19 Vaccine? Evidence from Discrete Choice Experiments and VSL Benchmarks
affiliations: Washington State University, Regenstrief Institute, Indiana University, Naval Postgraduate School and Indiana University

detail.title: How Undervalued is the Covid-19 Vaccine? Evidence from Discrete Choice Experiments and VSL Benchmarks
detail.abstract: Two discrete choice experiments conducted early in the Covid-19 vaccination campaign show that people dramatically undervalue the Covid-19 vaccine, relative to benchmarks implied by the value of a statistical life (VSL). Our first experiment found that median willingness to pay (WTP) for initial vaccination is around $50, only 2 percent of the WTP implied by standard VSL calculations. Our second experiment found the median person was willing to accept (WTA) about $200 to delay the second dose, only 32 percent of the WTA implied by standard VSL calculations. While standard economic models imply that vaccines are undervalued because of their large externalities, we interpret the finding that WTP estimates are well below the VSL benchmarks as evidence that internalities play a substantial role. This evidence that people undervalue even the private benefits of vaccination suggests that there may be a role for government beyond conventional efforts to correct externalities.

AI.tldr: 研究发现人们在新冠疫苗接种中严重低估疫苗价值，支付意愿仅为统计生命价值计算基准的2%，接受延迟接种的补偿要求仅为基准的32%，表明内部性因素在疫苗低估中起重要作用。
AI.research_question: 人们在新冠疫苗接种中是否低估了疫苗的价值？这种低估程度有多大？
AI.motivation: 了解人们在疫苗接种决策中如何评估疫苗价值，以及这种评估与标准经济模型预测的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值统计生命理论、支付意愿与接受补偿意愿理论、外部性与内部性理论
AI.method: 两个离散选择实验，分别测量初始疫苗接种的支付意愿和延迟第二剂接种的接受补偿意愿
AI.findings: 初始疫苗接种的中位支付意愿约为50美元，仅为标准VSL计算基准的2%；延迟第二剂接种的中位接受补偿意愿约为200美元，仅为标准VSL计算基准的32%
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了内部性因素在疫苗价值评估中的重要作用，挑战了传统仅关注外部性的经济模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府制定疫苗接种政策提供依据，建议政府除了纠正外部性外，还需要关注和纠正内部性问题

title: Diffusing Innovations Under Market Competition: Evidence from Drug-Eluting Stents
affiliations: University of Maryland - Department of Economics,  and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Diffusing Innovations Under Market Competition: Evidence from Drug-Eluting Stents
detail.abstract:
This paper investigates how hospital competition and insurance reimbursement policy shape the diffusion of medical innovations. Using patient-level data from Taiwan's drug-eluting stent (DES) market in the Taipei metropolitan area, we estimate a structural model of hospital behavior, incorporating patient demand and hospitals' endogenous portfolio and pricing decisions. Our analysis reveals a fundamental trade-off: intense competition lowers prices but weakens hospitals' incentives to adopt new technologies, with total welfare peaking at an intermediate level of concentration. We then evaluate policy solutions. Selective contracting—where the government insurer negotiates exclusive wholesale discounts—can achieve a ``quadruple-win'' for consumers, hospitals, participating manufacturers, and the payer. In contrast, increasing the insurer's DES-specific reimbursement encourages hospitals to expand DES technology adoption and lower patient payment per DES, but creates a substantial fiscal burden for the insurer. Alternatively, a patient coupon program targeting low-income patients improves equity but has limited market-wide impact, as hospitals barely modify their price or portfolio decisions in response. These findings highlight that effective technology diffusion policies must account for downstream hospitals' strategic responses and their market competition.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨医院竞争和保险报销政策如何影响医疗创新扩散。研究发现激烈竞争降低价格但削弱医院采用新技术的动力，总福利在中等集中度时达到峰值。选择性合同可实现四方共赢，而提高报销率会带来财政负担。
AI.research_question: 医院竞争和保险报销政策如何影响医疗创新（药物洗脱支架）的扩散？
AI.motivation: 理解医疗创新扩散的驱动因素，为政策制定提供依据，平衡价格、创新采用和社会福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医院行为结构模型，包含患者需求、医院内生投资组合和定价决策。
AI.method: 使用台湾台北都市区药物洗脱支架市场的患者层面数据，估计结构模型。
AI.findings: 激烈竞争降低价格但削弱创新采用动力；选择性合同可实现四方共赢；提高报销率促进技术采用但增加财政负担；患者优惠券改善公平性但影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了医院竞争与创新扩散之间的基本权衡关系，为医疗创新政策设计提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体可行的政策方案评估，包括选择性合同、报销政策调整和患者补贴等策略的比较分析。

title: Assessing the Role of Global Demand and Supply Shocks in the Recent US Inflation Experience Using a Cross-Country Panel Dataset of Professional Forecasts
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: Assessing the Role of Global Demand and Supply Shocks in the Recent US Inflation Experience Using a Cross-Country Panel Dataset of Professional Forecasts

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Although there have been a range of studies investigating the role and importance of global supply and demand shocks in US inflation developments during and since the pandemic, this study uses a heretofore unused dataset for this purpose: a quarterly panel of professional forecasts from Consensus Economics. We use real-time data with daily vintage snapshots since 2005 from the Federal Reserve Board of Governors FAME database to disentangle forecast errors from revisions and to exploit the monthly frequency and partial availability of CPI inflation and industrial production. Our measures of global demand and supply shocks account for nearly 60 percent, and 20 percent, respectively, of the total variability of the five global factors we identify. The global demand shock accounts for a greater share of unanticipated US economic activity growth and inflation than the global supply shock both prior to the pandemic and during and after 2020. Since 2020, however, global demand and global supply shocks have accounted for similar shares of the nowcast errors for US inflation.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用专业预测数据，分析全球供需冲击对美国通胀的影响。发现全球需求冲击在疫情前后对美国经济活动增长和通胀的意外变化贡献更大，而疫情后全球供需冲击对通胀预测误差的贡献相似。
AI.research_question: 全球供给和需求冲击在美国疫情期间及之后通胀发展中的作用和重要性是什么？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究探讨全球供需冲击对美国通胀的影响，但本研究首次使用专业预测数据集来深入分析这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全球因素分解和预测误差分析的理论框架，区分预测误差与数据修订的影响。
AI.method: 使用Consensus Economics的季度专业预测面板数据，结合美联储FAME数据库的实时数据，利用CPI通胀和工业生产的月度频率和部分可用性。
AI.findings: 全球需求冲击解释了约60%的全球因素变异性，供给冲击解释了约20%。疫情前后，全球需求冲击对美国经济活动增长和通胀意外变化的贡献都大于供给冲击。但疫情后，两者对通胀预测误差的贡献相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了使用专业预测数据研究全球冲击的新方法，改进了对全球供需冲击的识别和量化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解通胀驱动因素提供实证依据，特别是在疫情期间全球冲击对通胀的影响机制。

title: The Price of Delay: Supply Chain Disruptions and Pricing Dynamics
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: The Price of Delay: Supply Chain Disruptions and Pricing Dynamics

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the role of supply chain disruptions in shaping consumer prices, focusing on both firms' own import shocks and strategic responses to competitors' disruptions. Using a newly constructed microlevel dataset that links transaction-level US import data from bills of lading with high-frequency consumer prices and sales from a consumer panel, we develop a novel approach to estimate the price effects of cost shocks and product availability. Motivated by a model of delivery delays, cost shocks, and firm pricing, we implement a shift-share identification strategy based on delivery shortfalls, port congestion, and freight and import costs. We find sizable pass-through elasticities: firms raise prices in response to higher import costs and delivery delays, especially when disruptions persist. We also identify strategic pricing: firms—including non-importers—increase prices in response to competitors' supply chain disruptions. Using our estimates and back-of-the-envelope calculations from the model, we show that strategic interactions significantly amplified the direct effects of supply chain shocks on consumer prices during the pandemic.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了供应链中断对消费者价格的影响，包括企业自身进口冲击和竞争对手供应链中断的战略反应。研究发现企业会因进口成本上升和交付延迟而提高价格，且竞争对手的供应链中断也会引发战略定价行为，这些因素在疫情期间显著放大了供应链冲击对消费者价格的直接影响。
AI.research_question: 供应链中断如何影响消费者价格？企业自身进口冲击和竞争对手供应链中断的战略反应分别起到什么作用？
AI.motivation: 理解供应链中断对消费者价格的影响机制，特别是在疫情期间供应链冲击加剧的背景下，分析企业定价策略如何放大这些冲击的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于交付延迟、成本冲击和企业定价的模型，结合战略定价理论，分析企业在面对自身和竞争对手供应链中断时的定价行为。
AI.method: 使用新构建的微观数据集，将美国提单交易级进口数据与高频消费者价格和销售数据相结合，采用基于交付短缺、港口拥堵以及货运和进口成本的shift-share识别策略。
AI.findings: 发现较大的转嫁弹性：企业会因进口成本上升和交付延迟而提高价格，特别是在中断持续时；识别出战略定价行为：包括非进口商在内的企业会因竞争对手的供应链中断而提高价格。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了供应链中断影响消费者价格的理论框架，强调了战略互动在放大供应链冲击影响中的重要作用，扩展了企业定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解供应链冲击传导机制的工具，帮助企业更好地应对供应链中断，并为消费者价格预测提供了实证依据。

title: COBOLing Together UI Benefits: How Delays in Fiscal Stabilizers Affect Aggregate Consumption

detail.title: COBOLing Together UI Benefits: How Delays in Fiscal Stabilizers Affect Aggregate Consumption

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The United States experienced an unprecedented increase in unemployment insurance (UI) claims beginning in March 2020. State UI-benefit systems were strained beyond their administrative capacity to process the dual challenge of an unprecedented increase in claims and changes to UI benefits. In states that used an antiquated programming language, COBOL, to process claims, potential claimants experienced a larger increase in administrative difficulties, resulting in longer delays in benefit disbursement. States that used an antiquated UI-benefit system experienced a 2.8 percentage point decline in total credit and debit card consumption relative to card consumption in states with more modern UI benefit systems. Furthermore, states that used these antiquated systems experienced at least a 2.1 percentage point increase in the share of claims that were delayed by more than 70 days.

AI.tldr: 使用过时COBOL编程语言的州失业救济系统在处理2020年疫情失业救济申请时出现更多管理困难，导致救济金发放延迟更长，信用卡消费下降2.8个百分点，延迟超过70天的申请比例增加至少2.1个百分点。
AI.research_question: 过时的失业救济系统（特别是使用COBOL编程语言的系统）如何影响疫情期间失业救济申请的行政处理效率和救济金发放？
AI.motivation: 2020年3月起美国失业救济申请激增，各州失业救济系统面临前所未有的管理压力，特别是使用过时技术的系统可能无法有效处理申请和发放救济金。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行政能力理论和技术效率理论，探讨过时技术系统在危机时期对公共服务交付的影响。
AI.method: 比较分析使用COBOL编程语言的过时失业救济系统与更现代系统的州在处理失业救济申请时的表现差异。
AI.findings: 使用过时COBOL系统的州出现更多行政困难，救济金发放延迟更长，信用卡消费下降2.8个百分点，延迟超过70天的申请比例增加至少2.1个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了过时技术系统在危机时期会显著降低公共服务效率，支持行政能力理论在数字时代的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府机构提供证据，强调更新过时技术系统的重要性，特别是在关键公共服务领域，以提高危机应对能力。

title: On Model Aggregation and Forecast Combination
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta and Emory University

detail.title: On Model Aggregation and Forecast Combination

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Policy makers express their views and decisions via the lens of a particular model or theory. But since any model is a highly stylized representation of the unknowable object of interest, all these models are inherently misspecified, and the resulting ambiguity injects uncertainty in the decision-making process. We argue that entropy-based aggregation is a convenient device to confront this uncertainty and summarize relevant information from a set of candidate models and forecasts. The proposed aggregation tends to robustify the decision-making process to various sources of risks and uncertainty. We find compelling evidence for the advantages of entropy-based aggregation for forecasting inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用熵基聚合方法来解决政策制定中模型误设带来的不确定性，该方法能有效汇总多个候选模型和预测的信息，增强决策过程的稳健性，并在通胀预测中显示出明显优势。

AI.motivation: 政策制定者通过特定模型或理论表达观点和决策，但所有模型都是对未知对象的简化表示，存在固有误设，这种模糊性给决策过程带来不确定性。

AI.method: 熵基聚合方法，通过信息熵原理汇总多个候选模型和预测的信息
AI.findings: 熵基聚合能够显著增强决策过程对各种风险和不确定性的稳健性，在通胀预测中显示出明显优势

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对模型不确定性的实用工具，特别是在通胀预测等宏观经济决策中具有重要应用价值

title: A Uniformly Valid Test for Instrument Exogeneity
affiliations: Concordia University, Quebec and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: A Uniformly Valid Test for Instrument Exogeneity

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies the limiting behavior of the test for instrument exogeneity in linear models when there is uncertainty about the strength of the identification signal. We consider the test for conditional moment restrictions with an expanding set of constructed instruments. We establish the uniform validity of the standard normal asymptotic approximation, under the null, of this specification test over all possible degrees of model identification. As a result, this allows the researcher to use standard inference for testing instrument exogeneity without the need of any prior knowledge if the instruments are strong, semi-strong, weak, or completely irrelevant. Furthermore, we show that the test is consistent regardless of the instrument strength; i.e., even in cases (weak and completely irrelevant instruments) where the standard tests fail to exhibit asymptotic power. To obtain these results, we characterize the rate of the estimator under a drifting sequence for the identification signal. We illustrate the appealing properties of the test in simulations and an empirical application.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在识别信号强度不确定的情况下，线性模型中工具变量外生性检验的极限行为。我们考虑了具有扩展构造工具变量集的条件矩约束检验，建立了标准正态渐近近似在零假设下对所有可能模型识别程度的均匀有效性。这使得研究人员可以使用标准推断来检验工具变量外生性，而无需事先知道工具变量是强、半强、弱还是完全不相关的。此外，我们证明了该检验在所有工具变量强度下都是一致的，即使在标准检验缺乏渐近功效的情况下（弱和完全不相关工具变量）。
AI.research_question: 在识别信号强度不确定的情况下，线性模型中工具变量外生性检验的极限行为是什么？
AI.motivation: 在实证研究中，研究人员经常面临工具变量强度不确定的问题，而标准的工具变量外生性检验在弱工具变量情况下可能失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件矩约束检验、构造工具变量集扩展、识别信号漂移序列、渐近理论
AI.method: 理论推导和模拟分析，通过构造工具变量集的扩展和识别信号漂移序列来研究检验的极限行为
AI.findings: 标准正态渐近近似在零假设下对所有可能模型识别程度都是均匀有效的；该检验在所有工具变量强度下都是一致的，包括弱和完全不相关工具变量的情况
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了工具变量外生性检验在识别信号强度不确定情况下的渐近理论框架；证明了检验的均匀有效性和一致性
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究人员提供了无需事先知道工具变量强度即可进行有效外生性检验的方法；在弱工具变量情况下仍能保持检验功效

title: Underwater: Strategic Trading and Risk Management in Bank Securities Portfolios
affiliations: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Underwater: Strategic Trading and Risk Management in Bank Securities Portfolios

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-31
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use bond-level data to study how US banks manage risk in their securities portfolios, focusing on the period of rapidly-rising interest rates in 2022-23, and examine the role of financial and regulatory frictions in shaping bank behavior. Interest rate risk in bank portfolios increased sharply as rates rose, with significant cross-bank heterogeneity depending on ex ante holdings of bonds with embedded options. In response, exposed banks shortened the duration of bond purchases but did not actively sell risky securities or expand “qualified” hedging activity; securities also played a limited role in banks’ responses to deposit outflows. We identify two frictions that can help explain this inertia. First, we find that banks are highly averse to selling underwater bonds at a discount to book value—e.g., banks were 8-9 times more likely to trade bonds with unrealized gains than unrealized losses in 2022-23. This “strategic” trading is more pronounced for banks that do not recognize unrealized losses in regulatory capital and banks facing stock market pressure. Second, frictions in establishing qualified accounting hedges limited hedging activity depending on bond type and accounting classification. Banks did, however, reduce the interest-rate sensitivity of regulatory capital by classifying the riskiest bonds as held-to-maturity.

AI.tldr: 本文使用债券级数据研究美国银行在2022-23年利率快速上升期间如何管理证券组合风险，发现银行对出售账面价值折价债券高度厌恶，且合格会计对冲存在摩擦，导致银行主要通过将高风险债券分类为持有至到期来降低监管资本利率敏感性。
AI.research_question: 美国银行在利率快速上升期间如何管理证券组合风险？金融和监管摩擦在塑造银行行为中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 研究2022-23年利率快速上升期间银行风险管理的动态，特别关注金融和监管摩擦对银行行为的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行风险管理理论、监管资本约束理论和会计处理摩擦理论。
AI.method: 使用债券级数据分析银行证券组合管理行为，包括交易模式、对冲活动和会计分类选择。
AI.findings: 1. 银行对出售账面价值折价债券高度厌恶（2022-23年交易未实现收益债券的可能性比未实现损失债券高8-9倍）；2. 合格会计对冲存在摩擦限制了银行对冲活动；3. 银行通过将高风险债券分类为持有至到期来降低监管资本利率敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并量化了银行风险管理中的两个关键摩擦：出售折价债券的厌恶和合格对冲的会计摩擦，深化了对银行风险承担行为的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了关于银行风险管理和监管政策有效性的实证证据，有助于改进银行风险监管框架。

title: Contractibility Design
affiliations: Stanford University, Yale University and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Contractibility Design
detail.abstract:
We introduce a model of incentive contracting in which the principal, in addition to writing contracts, must engage in contractibility design: creating an evidence structure that allows them to prove when the agent has breached the contract. Designing an evidence structure entails both (i) front-end costs borne ex ante, such as those of drafting contracts, and (ii) back-end costs borne ex post, such as those of generating evidence. We find that, under even small front-end costs, optimal contracts are coarse, specifying finitely many contingencies out of a continuum of possibilities. In contrast, under even large back-end costs, optimal contracts are complete. Applied to the design of procurement contracts, our results rationalize: (i) the discreteness of contracts, (ii) the presence of similarly vague contracts in low-stakes and high-stakes settings, and (iii) the discontinuous adjustment of contracts to changes in the economic environment.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个激励契约模型，其中委托人除了制定契约外，还需要进行可契约性设计：创建证据结构以证明代理人违约。研究发现，即使前端成本很小，最优契约也是粗糙的，在连续可能性中只规定有限数量的意外情况；而即使后端成本很大，最优契约也是完整的。这些发现解释了采购契约设计的离散性、模糊契约在不同风险环境中的存在，以及契约对经济环境变化的不连续调整。
AI.research_question: 在激励契约设计中，前端成本（事前成本）和后端成本（事后成本）如何影响最优契约的结构和完整性？
AI.motivation: 传统契约理论假设契约是完全可执行的，但现实中委托人需要创建证据结构来证明违约，这涉及前端和后端成本。理解这些成本如何影响契约设计对于解释现实世界契约的离散性和模糊性具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励契约理论、可契约性设计、证据结构理论、前端成本与后端成本分析
AI.method: 理论模型构建，分析在存在前端成本（如起草成本）和后端成本（如证据生成成本）的情况下，最优契约的设计特征
AI.findings: 1. 即使前端成本很小，最优契约也是粗糙的，只规定有限数量的意外情况；2. 即使后端成本很大，最优契约也是完整的；3. 这些发现解释了现实世界中契约的离散性、模糊契约的存在以及契约调整的不连续性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 引入了可契约性设计的概念；2. 区分了前端成本和后端成本对契约设计的不同影响；3. 为理解契约的离散性和模糊性提供了理论解释
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为采购契约设计提供了理论指导；2. 解释了为什么现实中契约往往是离散的；3. 说明了为什么模糊契约在不同风险环境中都存在；4. 揭示了契约调整的不连续性质

title: The Social and Individual Effects of Homeless Shelter: Evidence from Temporary Shelter Provision
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford University - Department of Economics and Stanford University, Law School

detail.title: The Social and Individual Effects of Homeless Shelter: Evidence from Temporary Shelter Provision
detail.abstract:
What does homeless shelter achieve? We leverage administrative records of homeless services in Los Angeles County to construct a novel dataset of daily, site-level counts of shelter beds and occupants from 2014 to 2019. We pair this with daily, block-level crime incident data and daily, hospital-level data on ER visits to assess the relationship between shelter and area crime and health. We exploit variation from shocks to shelter availability from Los Angeles County's winter shelters program to study the effects of providing temporary shelter. We find that reducing unsheltered homelessness significantly reduces crime and ER visits for psychiatric conditions. We conclude with evidence that entering shelter also reduces short-run mortality but find no evidence that temporary shelter reduces future homelessness more than street outreach or other non-shelter services. Our findings suggest that shelter functions as a public good with high social benefits. When agents charged with provision of homeless services are evaluated on their ability to reduce overall homelessness, they are unlikely to internalize these benefits and may under provide shelter.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用洛杉矶县无家可归者服务的行政记录，分析临时收容所对犯罪率和急诊就诊的影响。研究发现减少无家可归者能显著降低犯罪和精神病急诊就诊，但临时收容所并不比街头外展服务更能减少未来的无家可归问题。
AI.research_question: 无家可归者收容所对社区犯罪率和公共卫生有什么影响？临时收容所是否能有效减少未来的无家可归问题？
AI.motivation: 理解无家可归者收容所的社会效益，为政策制定者提供关于收容所投资决策的依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共物品理论，分析收容所作为公共物品的社会效益。
AI.method: 利用洛杉矶县2014-2019年行政记录，构建收容所床位和入住人数的日度数据，结合犯罪事件和急诊就诊数据，运用冬季收容所计划带来的外生冲击进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 减少无家可归者显著降低犯罪率和精神病急诊就诊；临时收容所降低短期死亡率；但临时收容所在减少未来无家可归方面并不优于街头外展服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 为收容所作为公共物品的理论提供了实证支持，揭示了收容所的社会效益。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了收容所投资决策的依据，建议在评估无家可归服务时应考虑收容所的社会效益。

title: Option Value of Apex Predators: Evidence from a River Discontinuity
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics, University of Wisconsin at Madison and University of Wisconsin at Madison

detail.title: Option Value of Apex Predators: Evidence from a River Discontinuity
detail.abstract:
"Option value" provides theoretical justification for conserving wildlife species lacking known value, but empirical assessments of actual realizations are rare. We examine quasi-option value in the context of gray wolf eradication, which aimed to protect humans and their property historically, but also reduced the potential for wolves to improve human well-being today. We estimate the effects of long-run differences in the presence of wolves north, but not south, of Canada’s Saint Lawrence River on animal-related (primarily deer) vehicle collisions. Wolves reduce the share of animal collisions by 38 percent, reducing risk to human life and property.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过研究加拿大圣劳伦斯河北岸与南岸狼群存在与否的长期差异，发现狼群能将动物相关车辆碰撞事故的比例降低38%，从而降低对人类生命和财产的风险。这为保护缺乏已知价值的野生动物物种提供了实证支持。
AI.research_question: 狼群的存在如何影响动物相关车辆碰撞事故？
AI.motivation: 为保护缺乏已知价值的野生动物物种提供实证依据，检验"选择价值"理论在现实中的实现情况
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择价值理论 - 保护缺乏已知价值的野生动物物种的理论基础
AI.method: 利用加拿大圣劳伦斯河北岸（有狼群）与南岸（无狼群）的长期差异进行准自然实验，分析动物相关车辆碰撞数据
AI.findings: 狼群能将动物相关车辆碰撞事故的比例降低38%，主要通过对鹿群等动物的捕食调节作用
AI.theory_contributions: 为选择价值理论提供了实证支持，证明保护看似"无价值"的野生动物确实能带来实际效益
AI.practical_contributions: 为野生动物保护政策提供科学依据，证明狼群等捕食者通过生态调节作用能显著降低交通事故风险，保护人类生命财产安全

detail.abstract: How do we evaluate the welfare gains from transportation infrastructure investment? We present a quantitative spatial framework that integrates both traffic and economic responses to infrastructure investment and derive the elasticity of aggregate welfare to improvements in the transportation network. This approach extends the traditional "social savings" method to incorporate agglomeration and dispersion externalities and endogenous traffic congestion. We calibrate the model to the US freight transport network and assess the welfare impact of upgrading segments of the US Interstate Highway System, quantifying the marginal gains from improvements in specific corridors and highlighting where the returns to investment are highest.

title: Disentangling Age, Time, and Cohort Effects in Income Inequality: A Proxy Machine Learning Approach
affiliations: Stanford University, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Finance and Columbia University

detail.title: Disentangling Age, Time, and Cohort Effects in Income Inequality: A Proxy Machine Learning Approach
detail.abstract:
A canonical finding from earlier research is that the cross-sectional variance of income increases sharply with age Deaton and Paxson (1994). However, the trend in this age profile is not separately identified from time and cohort trends. Conventional methods solve this identification problem by ruling out "time effects." This strong assumption is rejected by the data. We propose a new proxy variable machine learning approach to disentangle age, time and cohort effects. Using this method, we estimate a significantly smaller slope of the age profile of income variance for the US than conventional methods, as well as less erratic slopes for 11 other countries.

title: Perceptions of Public Debt and Policy Expectations: Evidence from Cross Country Surveys
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Fiscal Affairs Department

detail.title: Perceptions of Public Debt and Policy Expectations: Evidence from Cross Country Surveys
detail.abstract:
Utilizing large-scale surveys of over 27,000 respondents across 13 advanced and emerging market economies conducted between April and May 2024, we examine how knowledge, beliefs, and preferences regarding government debt shape expectations about tax and spending policies. Our findings reveal significant gaps in public understanding of fiscal policy. Individuals consistently underestimate debt levels, particularly in high-debt countries, and tend to believe that fiscal adjustments will disproportionately affect them. We further show that greater lifetime exposure to fiscal consolidation is associated with increased pessimism about future economic prospects, reduced trust in government, and heightened expectations of rising debt, future tax increases, spending cuts, and inflation. Through randomized controlled experiments, we assess the causal impact of providing information about actual debt levels on household expectations. Informing respondents about their country’s debt levels lowers expectations of tax increases in contexts of stable debt and raises expectations of spending cuts in countries with rising debt. The effect of this information is moderated by individuals’ past experiences with fiscal consolidation, underscoring the interplay between historical context and current perceptions of fiscal policy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模调查和实验，研究了公众对政府债务的认知如何影响税收和支出政策预期。研究发现公众普遍低估债务水平，且过去财政紧缩经历会加剧对未来经济的悲观预期。提供债务信息会改变政策预期，但效果受个人历史经验调节。

title: Education and Selection into Ethnic Identification: Evidence from Roma People in Romania
affiliations: University of Gothenburg, Harvard University, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, University of Quebec at Montreal (UQAM) - Université du Québec à Montréal and Columbia University - School of International & Public Affairs (SIPA)

detail.title: Education and Selection into Ethnic Identification: Evidence from Roma People in Romania
detail.abstract:
How does ethnic identification vary with education among disadvantaged minorities? We study this question for Roma people, Europe's largest ethnic minority, using linked Romanian census data and birth records. We measure how individuals change reported ethnicity over time, or “pass.” Roma identification strongly declines with education, from 80% for those with no education to 40% for postsecondary graduates. We estimate a model with persistent individual heterogeneity and find 3-6 times more Roma postsecondary graduates than in official data. Survey data we collect shows that most Romanians are unaware of these patterns. Such selective passing may reinforce stereotypes about marginalized groups.

title: On the Optimality of Deferred Public Annuities
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics

detail.title: On the Optimality of Deferred Public Annuities
detail.abstract:
What is the optimal path of Social Security benefits for an individual who has retired with a stock of wealth, faces stochastic mortality, and has no access to annuities and no preferences for bequests? It is a deferred annuity in which the government annuity pays out zero for some periods and a constant amount after that. The optimal length of the deferral period is increasing in the retiree's initial wealth and in their survival probability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在随机死亡率、无法购买年金且无遗赠偏好的情况下，退休人员的最优社会保障福利路径。研究发现最优策略是延迟年金，即政府年金在初期支付为零，之后支付固定金额。延迟期限随退休人员初始财富和生存概率的增加而延长。

title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
affiliations: University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics, University of California, Irvine - Department of Economics and University of California, Irvine

detail.title: Ordinary Life Insurance: The Best-Performing Financial Asset of the 1930s
detail.abstract:
From 1900 to 1940, ordinary working- and middle-class families saved for retirement and contingencies via ordinary life insurance policies. These policies combined insurance and savings in a single financial instrument that paid its face value to insured individuals who survived until maturity and to beneficiaries if the insured died before the maturity date. The popularity of these policies peaked before WWII when a substantial share of all households and most of the middle class invested in them. This paper explains why these policies were the most popular savings vehicle of their day. Ordinary life policies were well suited to the early twentieth-century economic environment. They had good returns; low risks; tax advantages; and little correlation with returns of competing investments, like bank deposits, building and loan shares, postal savings deposits, real estate, or stocks. The policies protected households from poverty in old age, from the premature death of their breadwinner, and from other risks including disability and deflation. Understanding how households saved in the past has implications for a wide range of literatures in the social sciences.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
